jobs.description:
Location: Overland Park, KS (Kansas City Metro)
Employment Type: Full-time, In-Office
Department: CX
Compensation: $70,000/year + bonus (OTE $75,000) increasing to $82,500 after 18 months
Steadily is hiring a Customer Support Specialist to join our growing Client Experience team in the Kansas City metro area. In this role, you’ll provide fast, accurate support to our landlords, lenders, and independent agents while helping us deliver world-class insurance service.
There is great advancement opportunity in Client Experience. Every six months as your skills increase, you will receive a $2,500 raise so your compensation will be $82,500 by 18 months. Once you level up into a Senior role, the floor is even higher.
We’re looking for a detail-oriented professional with strong communication skills who thrives in a fast-paced, customer-facing role. This is a full-time, in-office position based in Overland Park, KS.
Below is a continuation of the job description, but if you'd like to see a visual overview of a day-in-the-life of, check this out.

As a Customer Support Specialist, you will:
- Respond to high volumes of calls and emails from insureds, lenders, and agents

- Handle policy servicing requests, including billing inquiries, document requests, and policy changes

- Process transactions across multiple carrier systems and maintain accurate records in Salesforce

- Manage clerical and administrative tasks related to policy servicing

What We’re Looking For
Required:
- Experience in a customer-focused role with excellent communication skills

- Quick to learn new tools and systems; comfortable navigating multiple platforms

- Ability to troubleshoot issues independently until fully resolved

- Ability to manage a large workload and thrive under pressure

Preferred (not required):
- 1+ years in a customer service or contact center role

Compensation & Benefits
- Compensation: $70,000 per year + bonus, OTE $75,000 (top of market in Kansas City Metro)

- Equity: Stock options in a fast-growing company

- Time Off: 3 weeks PTO + 6 federal holidays

- Insurance: Medical, dental, vision, life, disability, HSA, FSA

- Retirement: 401(k)

- Perks: Free snacks, team lunches, collaborative office culture

Location & Schedule
- Office located in Overland Park, KS (Kansas City Metro area)

- Steadily is building a workplace environment of team members who are passionate and excited to be together in person. This is an in-office position. Our office is in Overland Park, and is key to our fast-paced growth trajectory.

Why Join Steadily
- Good company. Our founders have three successful startups under their belt and have recruited a stellar team to match.

- Top compensation. We pay at the top of the Kansas City market (see comp).

- Growth opportunity: We’re an early-stage, fast-growing company where you’ll wear a lot of hats and shape product decisions.

- Strong backing. We’re growing fast, we manage over $2 billion in risk, and we’re exceptionally well-funded.

- Culture: Steadily boasts a very unique culture that our teammates love. We call it like we see it and we’re nothing if not candid. Plus, we love to have a good time. Check out our culture deck to learn what we’re all about.

- Awards: We've been recognized both locally and nationally as a top place to work. Recently we were ranked 16th on Forbes' 2026 Best Startup Employers list, and 63rd on the prestigious Inc 5000 Fastest Growing Companies list. We've also been recognized as one of the Best Landlord Insurance Companies in 2026 by CNBC, a Top 2025 Startup in Newsweek, in Investopedia's Best Landlord Insurance Companies, and we won Austin Business Journal's Best Places to Work in 2025.

We’re excited to meet you!

jobs.title: Superintendent
jobs.summary: Who We Are Invitation Homes is a team of more than 1,700 associates who come from all walks of life. We call different communities “home," but our shared values bind us together.
jobs.description:
Who We Are
Invitation Homes is a team of more than 1,700 associates who come from all walks of life. We call different communities “home," but our shared values bind us together. Invitation Homes is a place where possibility lives.

The market teams include our Leasing, Property Management and Rehab, Turns & Maintenance professionals. Together, our dedicated associates work hard to build excellent resident experiences while maintaining high-quality homes and ensuring potential residents are presented with a rental property they can’t refuse.

Your Role on the Team
As a Superintendent at Invitation Homes you are responsible for full-cycle oversight of property rehab and turnover efforts. This includes but is not limited to the following tasks:
- Meeting with residents to complete Pre Move-Out Visits and documenting the home condition and resident responsibilities for a successful move-out.

- Meeting with incoming residents to complete Resident Orientations to welcome them, and educate them on the systems in their home as well as all important maintenance policies and procedures

- Conducting Move Out Inspections including a detailed inspection of the property and using our budgeting program to create a comprehensive scope of work and identify costs that should be charged back to the resident at move-out in accordance with company standards

- Overseeing all aspects of the rehab and turn process which includes communicating with contractors, submitting change orders, ensuring work is completed correctly and on schedule, and documenting the process with progress notes and “before” and “after” photos

- Communicating with the Leasing Team about completion delays that might affect a resident’s move-in date

- Observing and ensuring job site safety during project management visits

- Negotiating terms of repairs with vendors and General Contractors based on company standards

- May be required to conduct occupancy checks and attend eviction lockouts/setouts in coordination with local law enforcement

- Performing other duties as assigned

Your Experience Includes
- High school diploma or equivalent

- OSHA 10 is required (new hires will have up to 90 days to complete OSHA 10 certification if not already certified)

- Minimum two years of project management experience managing multiple projects, budgets, timelines, and quality of work

- General knowledge of residential construction including plumbing, electrical, mechanical, HVAC, drywall, and flooring as well as local building codes

- Negotiating with and managing contractors to complete work

- Professional verbal and written communication skills

- Comfortability with using a tablet and general business applications (e.g. Outlook, Salesforce, etc.)

- Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills

- Current driver’s license and automobile insurance

- Must provide basic hand and power tools 

- Ability to be at work on a regular and consistent basis including on weekends and non-traditional holidays if needed

- Extensive travel within assigned portfolio required

- Physical requirements include:
- Frequent climbing, reaching, use of fingers, stooping, kneeling, crawling, pushing, pulling, lifting, talking, and hearing

- Ability to lift and/or move an excess of 50 pounds or more and operate standard maintenance equipment as assigned

Why Us
We stand for flexibility, opportunity, and a home that people can make their own. It’s as true for our associates as it is for our residents. Just like we help our residents live freer, we liberate our associates’ careers, too. Our associates know that goals matter, potential is unlocked, and careers thrive. Invitation Homes isn’t just a workplace but a possibility place. We offer each new associate:
- Competitive pay and an annual bonus program for all associates

- Generous paid time off plans including vacation accrual, sick time, volunteer time, and standard and floating holidays

- 401k with matching company contributions

- Awesome work environment with casual dress

- Team events and gatherings

- Employee resource groups: Together with Women, Asian Alliance, Black Collective, Juntos, Gen Next, Valor, and Open Invitation.

Build a foundation here and apply today!

Salary Range
The salary range for this position is: $57,862.50 - $100,295.00, plus individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications, location, and applicable employment laws.

Compensation and Benefits
To attract and retain top talent, we're pleased to offer competitive compensation and benefits, including:
- Annual bonus program

- Health, dental, vision, and life insurance

- Long-term and short-term disability insurance

- Generous paid time off plans include vacation accrual, sick time, standard holidays and floating holidays

- 401(k) with company matching contributions

- Awesome work environment with casual dress

- Team events and gatherings (Pre- and Post-Covid)

Invitation Homes is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and innovative environment with the best associates. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, Veteran status or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at humanresources@invitationhomes.com.

To all recruitment agencies: Invitation Homes does not accept agency resumes.  Please do not forward resumes to Invitation Homes employees.  Invitation Homes is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager
jobs.summary: Company Overview: Privately owned and operated, Digible was founded in 2017 with a mission to bring sophisticated digital marketing solutions to the multifamily industry.
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Privately owned and operated, Digible was founded in 2017 with a mission to bring sophisticated digital marketing solutions to the multifamily industry. We offer a comprehensive suite of digital services as well as a predictive analytics platform, Fiona, that is the first of its kind.

At Digible, Inc. we love to celebrate our diverse group of hardworking employees – and it shows. We pride ourselves on our collaborative, transparent, and authentic culture. These values are pervasive throughout every step of a Digible employee's journey. Starting with our interviews and continuing through our weekly All Hands Transparency Round-up, values are at the heart of working at Digible.

We value diversity and believe forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds and different industries to apply. Come join us and find out what the best work of your career could look like here at Digible.

Digible Core Values:

- Authenticity - The commitment to be steadfast and genuine with our actions and communication toward everyone we touch.

- Curiosity - The belief that a deep and fundamental curiosity (the "why") in our work is vital to company innovation and evolution.

- Focus - The collective will to remain completely devoted and ultimately accountable to our deliverables.

- Humility - The recognition and daily practice that "we" is always greater than "I".

- Happiness - The decision to prioritize passion and love for what we do above everything else.

The Role:

Digible is looking for a Senior Account Manager to join our team!

Our Client Services department is responsible for cultivating extraordinary relationships with our clients, making strategic recommendations that demonstrate a deep understanding of client goals, and ensuring digital campaigns and products are meeting and exceeding expectations.

The Senior Account Manager joining this team will be directly responsible for managing the agency's most strategically complex client relationships, characterized by higher MRR/ARR and requiring senior-level strategic guidance, cross-functional coordination, and proactive account leadership. The Senior Account Manager will own the strategic direction and performance of all digital aspects of their clients' campaigns, including all Digible’s Paid and Organic service offerings.

The Senior Account Manager will also act as a product expert for Digible’s tech platform, Fiona, serving as a resource for adoption, feedback, and strategic integration. The Senior Account Manager has in-depth digital knowledge, exceptional communication and leadership skills and thrives in a fast paced, collaborative environment.

You’ll love this job if you:

- Love talking to clients, building relationships and finding ways to proactively provide value

- Serve as the internal expert on your clients. Ask thoughtful, inquisitive questions to deepen your understanding of each client’s business, goals, challenges, and priorities.

- Are energized by developing others — you find real satisfaction in watching an AM you’ve coached level up

- Want to own client strategy, not just execute it — you think in terms of long-term portfolio health and expansion

- Are ready to lead department initiatives end-to-end, not just contribute to someone else’s

- Can balance a full client book with big-picture departmental thinking — and make both look easy

- Thrive on presenting to clients — QBOs, market analyses, strategic recommendations — you command the room

- Have a point of view on the industry and want to shape how Digible shows up as a thought leader

- Have an appetite for process improvement — you spot inefficiency and fix it, you don’t just flag it

- Naturally think “we” — and know that means developing the people around you, not just doing great solo work

What you’ll do:

Client Strategy, Retention & Expansion

- Serve as the primary strategic point of contact for a portfolio of 5–8 clients or one Enterprise Account spanning 110-130 properties, owning the health and direction of each relationship

- Lead Quarterly Business Outlooks (QBOs) — delivering in-depth market and portfolio analyses live to clients each quarter, paired with clear, data-backed expansion recommendations.

- Own both retention and expansion across the portfolio, proactively aligning solutions to client goals to drive measurable revenue growth.

- Oversee advanced, cross-channel digital marketing strategy spanning Paid Search, Paid Social, SEO, Organic Social, Geofencing, Display, Reputation Management, Email, and Native.

- Utilize Account Coordinators to execute all level 1 tasks

- Sustain a monthly retention rate of 96%+ and a client response time under 5 hours.

Department Leadership & Initiatives

- Lead departmental initiatives end-to-end, scoping the work, setting milestones, driving accountability, and owning the outcome.

- Identify and implement the latest technology (AI) to drive process improvements that strengthen scalability and efficiency across the team, turning lessons from individual accounts into reusable practices where appropriate.

- Contribute to company-level initiatives that fuel long-term departmental and business growth.

- Develop case studies and success stories that reinforce client investment and elevate Digible's market presence.

People Development & Mentorship

- Provide structured mentorship to Account Managers and Coordinators through regular check-ins, feedback on reporting interpretation and coaching next-level readiness

- Set and reinforce best practices across the team, acting as a standard-setter who makes successful approaches reusable rather than simply a top individual performer.

Product & Platform

- Support product demos and client onboarding to drive effective platform adoption and gather actionable user feedback

- Partner with Product and Development teams to translate client needs and usage patterns into feature enhancements and platform improvements

- Surface and help troubleshoot platform issues and bugs, ensuring client-impacting concerns are communicated and resolved effectively

- Provide input on product functionality, user experience, and UI improvements based on client feedback and real-world usage

Your Success Will Be Measured By:

- Retention % on assigned portfolio ≥96%

- CSAT ≥85

- Response time SLA: <5 hours

- Report accuracy: 100%

- QBO completion: 100% of assigned clients, quarterly

- Expansion recommendations delivered per quarter: ≥1

- % of expansion recommendations adopted

- % YoY revenue growth by client

- Mentorship: ≥2 AMs/Coordinators

While this job description outlines the core expectations of the role, it’s not a full list of everything you’ll do at Digible. We believe in leaning in — hitting your key goals, sharing insights, and finding new ways to elevate performance, process, and client success.

You should have:

- 6+ years in a client-facing role, with a proven track record of managing high-volume portfolios

- 5+ years of digital marketing experience including paid search, paid social, display, and geofencing

- Experience Working in a fast paced agency environment

- Proven success in delivering measurable growth for client portfolios

- Strong leadership and mentorship skills

- Demonstrated success leading Quarterly Business Reviews or equivalent executive-level client presentations

- Experience leading projects or initiatives from initiation through completion — not just contributing to them

- Strong leadership and mentorship skills — you’ve developed others and can point to their growth

- Multifamily, Senior Living, or Student Housing experience is a plus

Pay, perks and such:

- Annual Salary: $87k - $100K

- Discretionary Bonus

- 4-Day Work Week (32 Hour Work Week)

- WFA (work from anywhere)

- We offer 3 weeks of PTO as well as Sick leave, and Bereavement

- We offer 11 paid holidays

- 401(k) + Match

- 75% employer paid health benefits (Medical, Dental, and Vision)

- We offer $75/ month reimbursement for Physical Wellness

- We offer $75/ month reimbursement for Mental Wellness

- $1000/year travel fund for employees who have been with Digible 3+ years

- Dog-Friendly Office

- Paid Parental Leave

- Monthly Social Events

- Weekly Lunches and Snacks for in-office employees

HEADS UP! We believe in transparency throughout our hiring process. To help us ensure a great fit, we'll ask you to share a few professional references during the hiring process who can speak to your experience and skills. It’s all part of our commitment to open, honest communication and our core values: Focus, Authenticity, Humility, Curiosity, and Happiness.

jobs.description:
Lessen is the tech-enabled, end-to-end property service provider that is transforming how commercial and residential real estate services are delivered and managed at scale. Lessen’s technology platform provides data-driven insights that unlock key growth opportunities for the entire real estate ecosystem—including investors, owners, managers, and service providers. The company leverages a network of over 30,000 vetted, qualified vendors (Lessen Affiliates) serving clients with over 1 million properties and completing more than 3.5 million work orders annually across an expanding range of services. Lessen, LLC is a venture-backed, privately held company with offices in Scottsdale and Chicago. 

The Trade Specialist plays an integral role in customer and vendor support to a specific client base. This role is responsible for implementing and maintaining client and associate relationships, while serving as a specific trade related SME for complex issues and queries, proactively resolving their daily challenges. 
 
This role will require weekend and/or evening availability.
 
This is a remote position that must live near the Scottsdale, AZ or Chicago, IL office.

-
Proactively resolve vendor and client issues; drive all issues towards resolution and escalates on a timely basis only when necessary

-
Provide support to Trade Representative as required

-
Foster a positive work environment and collaborate effectively with all stakeholders

-
Ensure confidentiality of internal and external data

-
Perform ad-hoc projects and other duties as assigned

-
Maintain CPD and awareness of trade / industry developments

-
Seek opportunities for continuous process improvement

-
Customer Service Skills - Proficient

-
Verbal Communication Skills - Proficient

-
Written Communication Skills - Proficient

-

-

-
Negotiation Skills – Proficient

-

-

-
Computer Skills: Intermediate proficiencies in: Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook preferred

-
SME in a specific relevant trade

- HVAC field experience preferred

Qualifications

-
Bachelor’s Degree preferred

-
Relevant trade qualification

-
3 – 4 years of experience in relevant field or internal promotion from within Lessen

-
Experience working in an FM, retail, buildings environment

Demonstrable experience of solving complex trade related technical issues

jobs.description:
Are you a strategic builder who loves turning local insights into national momentum? TurboTenant is looking for a Director of Local Marketing to architect, own, and scale our go-to-market local playbook from a handful of key regions into a powerhouse national footprint. This isn’t just about buying billboards or managing budgets; it’s about taking complete ownership of how TurboTenant shows up in physical and digital communities across the country.

In this role, you’ll serve as the decision-maker for our local growth strategy, balancing out-of-home media, local SEO, community partnerships, and demand generation. You will partner fluidly across Product Marketing, Sales, Performance, and Escalations to build repeatable systems that accelerate market profitability and solidify TurboTenant as the premier property management platform in every neighborhood we touch.

Key Responsibilities:

- ROI-Driven Market Strategy: Every market you invest in hits its profitability targets faster because you've prioritized capital based on unit economics, sales capacity, and vendor supply — and you pull budget out of underperforming markets before it becomes a drag on the portfolio.

- Out-of-Home & Local Media: Local media spend consistently converts into pipeline, and every new market launches on a proven channel mix playbook instead of starting from scratch — cutting the time and guesswork it takes to find what works in a new region.

- Lead Generation & Conversion Optimization: Local lead sources are tuned to sales outcomes, not just volume — bid strategies shift in response to real conversion data, so spend keeps flowing toward the sources that actually close.

- Local SEO & Reputation Mastery: TurboTenant shows up first in local search across your markets, and customer sentiment trends positive — you and Escalations have turned review management into a growth lever instead of a defense.

- Community & Strategic Partnerships: Local sponsorships, events, and partnerships consistently build credibility with DIY landlords and property managers, because you've set clear deal criteria that keep every partnership tied to measurable brand or pipeline impact.

- Operational Precision: Every market goes live on day one fully compliant and fully operational — signage, PO boxes, and logistics are never the reason a launch slips.

- AI-Driven Market Expansion: As a result of AI tooling to inform market evaluation and planning, each launch gets faster and more effective. Tooling is shared, and team members are trained to make an impact on the entire org outside of just Local Marketing.

- Team Leadership & Scale: Your local marketing team scales ahead of the business's expansion plans, staffed with people who operate with urgency and an owner's mindset — and the team gets stronger, not thinner, as it grows.

Qualifications:

Required:

- 6+ years of marketing experience, including significant experience owning go-to-market strategy end-to-end

- 3+ years of experience setting strategy for local or out-of-home marketing (billboards, print, radio, or similar channels), not just executing within it

- 3+ years of experience managing budgets, with the ability to use operating costs and unit economics (CAC, LTV) to guide market-level investment decisions

- Experience hiring, coaching, and managing a team, with a track record of building high-performing teams

- Comfortable managing multiple vendor relationships and coordinating operational logistics, with strong reporting and data skills to track and communicate performance to leadership

Strongly preferred:

- 3+ years of experience partnering with or directly informing SEO strategy

- 3+ years of experience managing paid lead sources, bids, or performance-based marketing spend

- 2+ years of experience setting partnership, sponsorship, or event strategy — including defining deal criteria and investment levels

- Experience in the service industry, including working closely with call centers or sales teams to align marketing lead quality with conversion and revenue outcomes

Nice-to-have:

- Experience with brand reputation, review management, or customer escalations

- Negotiation experience

- Experience using tools such as Google Analytics, HubSpot, local SEO tools, and other data reporting platforms

Location & Connection:

Our Marketing team is based in Denver, Colorado. We believe in-person connection is essential to our culture, which is why this role follows a hybrid schedule. You will be expected in the office at least three days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday).

About Us:

At TurboTenant, we simplify the complex and intimidating process of managing your own rental property. And we do it through an elegant software platform for small, “do-it-yourself” landlords and their tenants. But don’t take our word for it—Read reviews from some of our 1 million landlords!

Our Be Better Culture:

At TurboTenant, we live by the Be Better mantra. Our high-performance culture makes us relentless in our efforts to Be Better at serving our landlords and renters, and in unlocking the potential in one another.

What does our Be Better culture mean to you?

- You’ll be in an environment that pushes you to reach your potential.

- You’ll make a massive impact on our landlords, renters, company, and the proptech industry.

- You’ll be on the highest performing team of your career.

We're Proud to Offer:

- Competitive compensation package

- 22 days of PTO during the first year, increasing with tenure

- Annual bonus based on company performance

- Equity – an owner’s mindset is a big part of being a member of the TurboTeam

- Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans – with multiple plans covered at 100%

- 9 paid holidays per year + a paid day off for your birthday

- 401k Matching

- Annual bike tune-up reimbursement

Compensation: $160,000 - $170,000 + equity. The actual compensation offered will be based on experience.

Salary Range
$160,000—$170,000 USD

Additional Information

TurboTenant is proud to serve a diverse group of landlords and renters. We strive to reflect that diversity within our team. Employment at TurboTenant is based on merit, competence, performance, and business need. TurboTenant celebrates being an equal opportunity employer and never discriminates based on race, color, genetic information, religion, national origin, sex, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), age, or any other basis protected by law.

At this time, employer-based visa sponsorship is not available. All candidates must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Next Steps

Ready to work on the highest performing team of your career at TurboTenant? Submit your resume and we’ll be in touch soon.

About Homeward

Homeward takes the “what ifs” out of homebuying by creating financial products that give buyers and sellers certainty and convenience. We’re a fast-paced, remote-first real estate startup that partners with real estate agents to offer innovative products and services, helping clients buy with cash, sell with certainty, and time their move, regardless of the market.

Today, we offer bundled cash offers, mortgage, and title services in 13 states, enabling buyers and sellers to move with certainty and convenience.

We’re a fully remote company with a diverse team spread across several countries - Grounded in three core values: The Golden Rule, One Team One Dream, and Calm Focus. Hear from our employees about what our values mean to them.

About the opportunity

We're seeking a Senior Back-end Engineer to help us build a simpler, more customer-centric home buying and selling experience in partnership with real estate agents.

Due to current team needs, we are only accepting candidates based in Latin America. This is intended to be a long-term contract position.

In this role you will:

- Deep understanding of web development and best practices

- Strong organizational skills and discipline in both following and appropriately challenging conventions

- Skilled with common back-end technologies and patterns such as ReST API development, asynchronous task management, and databases / data management best practices.

- Deep experience in one or more relevant back-end frameworks such as Django, Flask, or FastAPI

- Scrappy determination and flexibility - from updating email templates to building complex web apps; you’re eager to learn and help the team succeed.

CALM FOCUS. We work in tech and build solutions for real estate. Both are fast-paced and stressful industries. But by focusing on the larger objective rather than rushing from one task to the next, we can create solutions our customers love.

ONE TEAM, ONE DREAM. Big problems require big solutions. We look at our customers’ experiences holistically and recognize that solving them requires collaboration across teams and our three affiliate companies — Homeward, Homeward Mortgage and Homeward Title.

jobs.description:
What we do and why we do it

As the leading end-to-end investment platform for single-family rental homes (SFR), our mission is to reinvent the rental housing ecosystem for the benefit of all. We successfully merge our passion for helping investors build wealth through real estate with cutting edge technology that transforms the way they do it.

How it’s going (and growing)

With a talented team of 750+ Roofsters, our collaborative, can-do culture is what fuels our growth. In 2022, we closed on our Series E, raising $240 million, and have offices in the Bay Area and New York City. Our growth includes recent acquisitions of Stessa (financial and asset management software), RentPrep (tenant screening and placement service for landlords), and Mynd (property management platform for both Retail and Institutional investors). In 2025, Roofstock took an ownership stake in Casago (short-term rental management services), expanding our platform to support both long-term and short-term rental investment services.

About the Role

Roofstock is looking to hire an organized, systems-minded, and experienced Senior Legal Operations Manager to join our Legal team. This individual will own how legal work moves through the business: how it comes in, how it gets tracked, how it gets executed, and how it gets approved and paid. The Senior Legal Operations Manager will build durable workflows in place of institutional memory, keep contract turnaround predictable, maintain clean and complete records, support claims and litigation management in-house, and help manage outside counsel spend against budget. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad visibility, partnering closely with Finance, People Operations, Compliance, and the business teams that depend on Legal to move quickly.

Responsibilities

Legal Operations & Contract Management

- Contract Lifecycle Management: Own end-to-end contract intake, routing, workflow optimization, and status tracking using Zip.

- First-Line Agreement Review: Perform initial triage and review of incoming third-party agreements in Zip, evaluating red flags, indemnification terms, and standard boilerplate before escalating complex issues to attorneys.

- Process & Self-Service Optimization: Build and maintain contract templates, playbooks, and self-service tools to empower business teams and eliminate attorney bottlenecks on routine agreements.

- Repository & Record Management: Establish repository standards (e.g., Google Drive structure) and manage post-execution filing and signature routing so critical legal records remain organized, current, and accessible.

Financial Management & Outside Counsel Operations

- Spend Management & Billing: Oversee law firm billing guidelines, manage outside counsel engagements, and perform initial invoice reviews.

- Finance & Accounting Alignment: Track legal spend against department budgets and collaborate directly with Accounting and Finance on monthly accruals, reporting, and operational friction points.

- Vendor Negotiations: Support rate negotiations with outside counsel and evaluate third-party legal vendors.

Corporate Governance, Transactions & Claims (Paralegal Support)

- Entity Management & Cap Table: Manage corporate governance, state filings, annual reports, and registered agent coordination across multiple entities and jurisdictions. Maintain cap table and corporate records in Carta.

- Transaction Support: Coordinate document collection, diligence request tracking, and virtual data room administration (e.g., DataSite) for corporate transactions and financings.

- Litigation & Claims Support: Support in-house claims and litigation intake, issue litigation holds, corporate insurance, coordinate document collection, track deadlines, and liaise with outside litigation counsel.

Legal Technology & Department Analytics

- System Administration: Directly administer legal tooling, including Zip (CLM), Carta, e-signature tools, and billing software.

- Reporting & Metrics: Build and maintain operational dashboards that track legal work volume, spend trends, and process bottlenecks for leadership.

- AI & Automation: Identify and implement emerging AI tools and automation to reduce manual workflows while maintaining appropriate review protocols.

Qualifications

- 5+ years of total experience in legal operations, contract management, or paralegal roles, with a strong core background (3+ years) in corporate paralegal responsibilities.

- Experience in a high-growth, late-stage private company (Series B/C/E) or proptech/fintech/real estate environment preferred (public company experience is not required).

- Solid working understanding of key contract terms (indemnification, liability, boilerplate provisions), corporate entity management across multiple jurisdictions, and litigation hold procedures.

- Practical experience with litigation and claims management, including handling matter intake, issuing litigation holds, managing discovery/document collection, tracking critical deadlines, and coordinating with outside litigation counsel.

- Proven ability to partner across business functions, particularly Finance, Accounting, and Human Resources to streamline operational pain points.

- Adaptable "jack-of-all-trades" mindset and self-starter with strong ownership, high discretion, and a natural instinct to systematize and document processes.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required

- Advanced proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Excel

- Preferred practical exposure to Zip (CLM), Carta (cap table/entity management), DataSite (VDR), Serengeti/Tracker, or Ironclad

- High degree of ownership, attention to detail, and bias toward action

- Curiosity and willingness to use AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve efficiency while maintaining proper validation and judgment

- Real estate, proptech, fintech, or other regulated-industry experience preferred

Location

This position must be based in the greater Dallas area

Pay Transparency

Our compensation reflects several US geographic markets. The base pay for this position represents the expected salary for this position. Ultimately, in determining your pay it will be based on several factors including location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience and other job related factors. Roofstock is a total compensation company; the base salary is only a part of our total compensation package.

Competitive & Unique Benefits Package

- Generous PTO Policy

- 12 Paid Holidays

- Volunteer Time Off

- Paid Parental Leave

- 401k Program

- Wellness and home office/cell phone subsidies

- Robust health, dental, vision insurance, and more

- Wellness and home office/cell phone subsidies

Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background investigation.

Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity

Roofstock is an equal opportunity employer. In keeping with the values of Roofstock, we make all employment decisions including hiring, evaluation, termination, promotional and training opportunities, without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, physical handicap, mental disability, medical condition, disability, gender or identity or expression, pregnancy or pregnancy-related condition, marital status, height and/or weight.

You’ll have the opportunity to shape how Homeward structures, governs, and delivers data—enabling analysts, business users, applications, and AI-powered tools to work from consistent and trusted information.

- Hands-on experience building and maintaining production data models and semantic layers using dbt.

- Demonstrated experience owning or supporting data ingestion and transformation pipelines, including diagnosing failures and improving pipeline reliability.

- Experience designing data architecture that balances scalability, maintainability, usability, and business needs.

- Experience with AWS or a comparable cloud data environment.

- Experience with modern BI and analytics tools such as Looker, Hex, Tableau, or equivalent platforms.

- Working knowledge of Python and orchestration tools such as Airflow.

- Understanding of data governance principles, including metric definitions, data quality, documentation, lineage, and access.

- Familiarity with modern AI/LLM applications and AI-enabled data tooling, with an understanding of how data architecture needs to evolve to support AI use cases.

- Ability to translate business concepts and definitions into clear, maintainable technical models.

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently investigate ambiguous or complex data issues.

- Competitive hourly rate

Digible Company Overview

Privately owned and operated, Digible was founded in 2017 with a mission to bring sophisticated digital marketing solutions to the multifamily industry. We offer a comprehensive suite of digital services as well as a predictive analytics platform, Fiona, that is the first of its kind.

At Digible, Inc. we love to celebrate our diverse group of hardworking employees – and it shows. We pride ourselves on our collaborative, transparent, and authentic culture. These values are pervasive throughout every step of a Digible employee's journey. Starting with our interviews and continuing through our weekly All Hands Transparency Round-up, values are at the heart of working at Digible.

We value diversity and believe forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds and different industries to apply. Come join us and find out what the best work of your career could look like here at Digible.

Digible Core Values:

- Authenticity - The commitment to be steadfast and genuine with our actions and communication toward everyone we touch.

- Curiosity - The belief that a deep and fundamental curiosity (the "why") in our work is vital to company innovation and evolution.

- Focus - The collective will to remain completely devoted and ultimately accountable to our deliverables.

- Humility - The recognition and daily practice that "we" is always greater than "I".

- Happiness - The decision to prioritize passion and love for what we do above everything else.

The Role:

Digible, Inc. is looking for an SEO Strategist to join our team!

The SEO Strategist is a hands-on SEO practitioner and performance owner within Digible’s SEO practice. You manage a portfolio of local SEO campaigns across multifamily, student, senior, and single-family rental properties, applying professional judgment across technical, on-site, and off-site SEO. You directly execute when diagnosis, risk, ambiguity, or continuity materially benefits from Strategist expertise while leveraging SEO Coordinators for standardized implementation, recurring audits, listings, citations, data pulls, and other repeatable execution.

You'll love this job if:

- Take real satisfaction in making a measurable impact across a portfolio of accounts

- Are process-oriented and find genuine pleasure in improving how things work

- Learn quickly and proactively seek out knowledge from senior teammates

- Are passionate about SEO and hungry to go deeper on the technical side

- Take pride in accuracy, consistency, and never missing a deadline

- Thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where the work is always evolving

- Naturally think “we” instead of “I”

What you'll do:

SEO campaign execution:

- Manage a portfolio of up to 108 accounts, owning SEO performance and directly executing technical, local, and content work when professional judgment is required, while leveraging Coordinators for standardized implementation.

- Diagnose and prioritize on-site and off-site optimizations that drive organic visibility and keyword rankings; directly implement complex or nonstandard changes and delegate repeatable implementation where appropriate.

- Conduct website audits, determine the appropriate technical SEO recommendations, and implement or direct implementation based on complexity, risk, and whether continuity from diagnosis materially benefits the outcome.

- Own the strategic use and health of Google Business Profile, Google Tag Manager, and Google Search Console across assigned accounts while leveraging Coordinators for standardized maintenance and updates.

- Drive organic traffic and rankings through proven SEO fundamentals

- Flag accounts with declining visibility or technical health trends before they become a client-facing issue

Analysis & reporting:

- Analyze campaign performance and ROI and own the client-facing interpretation and recommendations, using standardized reporting support from Coordinators where available.

- Identify keyword visibility trends and translate findings into actionable next steps

- Support reporting improvements and contribute to internal documentation efforts

Collaboration & process:

- Partner with Senior SEO Strategists for advanced troubleshooting, testing, and strategic guidance

- Escalate strategic tradeoffs and technical risks with clear recommendations, not just problems

- Follow internal standards consistently, maintain documentation for Strategist-owned judgment workflows, and partner with Coordinators to keep execution procedures current as platforms and tools evolve.

- Work cross-functionally to deliver exceptional client and employee experiences

How success will be measured:

- Accounts per FTE: up to 108

Strategic Planning, Optimization, Scheduling, and Delegation for all accounts by the 5th Digible business day

- SVT Opportunity Recommendations: 1 per month

- SLA Adherence: ≥95%

- Support Annual Tests on 2-4 PMCs

- Campaign Optimization Completion: 100% within monthly cycle

- Thought Leadership Contributions: 2 per year

- Client Performance Growth: Organic visibility +10% YoY

You should have:

- 2–4 years of concentrated SEO experience

- Experience implementing local SEO campaigns across multiple markets

- Proficiency with on-site and off-site SEO strategies

- Working knowledge of Google Business Profile, GTM, and Google Search Console

- Experience conducting website audits and implementing technical SEO recommendations

- Google Analytics Certification

- Strong copywriting and research skills

- Familiarity with emerging AI integrations in SEO

- Strong communication skills, initiative, and high attention to detail

- Multifamily, student housing, or senior living experience is a plus

Pay, Perks and Such:

- Annual Salary of $70,000-$87,000

- 4-Day Work Week (32-hour work week)

- WFA (Work From Anywhere)

- Profit Sharing Bonus

- 3 weeks PTO plus Sick Leave and Bereavement

- 13 Paid Holidays

- 401(k) + 5% employer match

- 75% employer-paid Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

- $75/month Physical Wellness reimbursement

- $75/month Mental Wellness reimbursement

- $1,000 annual travel fund after 3 years

- Dog-Friendly Office

- Paid Parental Leave

- Company Sponsored Social Events

- Weekly lunches and snacks for in-office employees.

To help us ensure a great fit, we'll ask you to share a few professional references during the hiring process who can speak to your experience and skills. It’s all part of our commitment to open, honest communication and our core values: Focus, Authenticity, Humility, Curiosity, and Happiness.

Invitation Homes is a fast-paced, evolving publicly traded REIT that is pioneering a new industry with over 100,000 single-family rental homes and a market capitalization of over $16 billion. We are a team of more than 1,500 associates from all walks of life. We call different communities “home,” but our shared values bind us together. Invitation Homes is a place where possibility lives.

We are seeking a Vice President of Enterprise Data to lead and unify our Enterprise Data organization. This executive will oversee Product Strategy, Product Management and Product Ownership, Engineering and Architecture, bringing strategic vision, operational excellence, and strong leadership to a function central to how we acquire, operate, and grow our business. The VP will be responsible for aligning data strategy with business objectives, championing data governance across the enterprise, and ensuring our data platforms deliver measurable value to stakeholders at every level of the organization.

This leader will serve as the primary executive voice for Enterprise Data, communicating strategy, progress, and priorities to the C-suite and board-level audiences. They will build a high-performing team culture while driving the prioritization and delivery of data capabilities that support both real-time operations and long-term strategic planning.

Invitation Homes does not offer employment-based visa sponsorship for this role at this time.

What You’ll Do 
Team Leadership & Organizational Development 

- Report to the Head of Technology and provide executive leadership over the Enterprise Data organization, including Directors of Data Product and Data Engineering & Architecture

- 15+ years progressive experience in data management, engineering, product management, and/or enterprise analytics

- Track record building and scaling enterprise data organizations in publicly traded companies with SOX compliance

- Experience managing multi-million-dollar technology budgets and vendor relationships

- Preferred: real estate, SFR, multifamily, finance, hospitality, or retail industry experience 

Technical Knowledge 

- Modern data platforms and architecture: Data Lakes, EDW, data modeling, ETL/ELT, and BI solutions

- Data orchestration, observability, catalog, lineage, quality, and security tooling

At Invitation Homes, our associates are the foundation of our success. We connect your work to real impact, invest in your growth, and welcome you to feel at home — because care isn't just something we say, it's something you experience.

Invitation Homes owns and operates homes in great neighborhoods across 16 top U.S. markets. We continue to innovate with smart home technology, an industry-leading maintenance app, and other lifestyle-enhancing services that make leasing easier than owning.

Invitation Homes does not offer employment-based visa sponsorship for this role at this time.

What you’ll do day-to-day
The Vice President, Data Science will lead Invitation Homes’ data science function—owning the strategy, technical direction, and hands-on development of the quantitative models and machine learning systems that drive decision-making across marketing, resident acquisition and retention, customer experience, pricing, and portfolio performance. This is a hands-on leadership role split roughly evenly across three areas: partnering with senior leaders on strategy and roadmap, coaching and developing the team, and personally building and validating models. You will set the vision and standards for the team while staying close enough to the technical work to frame problems, build models, and shepherd them into production.

You will partner closely with senior marketing, operations, and technology leaders to identify high-value opportunities, shape the analytics roadmap, and deliver scalable, reliable solutions that improve the speed, consistency, and quality of business decisions. You will lead a small, high-performing team of data scientists and machine learning engineers, dividing your time between coaching and developing talent and personally contributing to the most complex, highest-impact work.

The ideal candidate is a proven technical leader who combines deep data science and machine learning expertise with strong business judgment and communication skills—someone who can translate ambiguous business problems into data-driven decision systems, mentor a growing team, and turn technical excellence into measurable business value.

Data Science Strategy & Business Partnership
- Define and own the strategy and roadmap for Invitation Homes’ data science and machine learning capabilities, aligning technical priorities with the company’s most valuable business opportunities.
- Partner with marketing, operations, revenue management, and technology leadership to identify, prioritize, and deliver analytical solutions with the greatest business impact—focused on resident acquisition, engagement, retention, and loyalty; customer experience; pricing; and long-term value.
- Translate complex business challenges into clear roadmaps, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes, and curate a backlog that sets expectations on the timing of deliverables.
- Represent data science in planning, prioritization, and investment discussions, and communicate findings and recommendations clearly to senior business stakeholders with supporting visualizations.

Technical & Analytical Leadership
- Dedicate roughly a third of your time to personal technical contribution—model development, experimentation, and validation—on the highest-impact work.
- Set technical standards and direction across modeling, experimentation, deployment, monitoring, and governance for the team.
- Provide leadership in advanced analytical methods including predictive modeling, forecasting, optimization, segmentation, and machine learning.
- Persistently assess the status quo, looking for opportunities to simplify, optimize, and improve existing analytical constructs and solutions.
- Evaluate and responsibly adopt emerging capabilities, including generative AI, where they create measurable business value.

Production Machine Learning & Decision Systems
- Own the full analytical and machine learning lifecycle—from framing business problems and developing models through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
- Ensure analytical and machine learning systems are designed as reliable, reproducible, and auditable end-to-end decision systems.
- Guide development of production-grade solutions on modern cloud-based data platforms.
- Institutionalize the processes of aggregating, organizing, and preparing data for analysis, and create stable refresh processes that keep findings and insights fresh.
- Advance modern engineering practices including version control, CI/CD, automation, and reusable delivery patterns.

Team Leadership & Talent
- Lead, mentor, and grow a small, high-performing team of data scientists and machine learning engineers, dedicating roughly a third of your time to coaching and developing talent.
- Attract, assess, hire, and retain exceptional technical talent, and develop team members through coaching and structured development.
- Establish a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
- Help upskill data and analytics expertise across the team and among business partners.

Quality, Governance & Continuous Improvement
- Establish high standards for reproducibility, data quality, code quality, validation, and production support.
- Ensure analytical decisions are correct, explainable, and defensible before deployment.
- Continuously improve the team’s operating model and delivery practices.
- Work closely with the business intelligence team to create on-brand visualizations and management tools that improve performance related to customer acquisition and experience.

What You Bring
Education and/or Experience
- BA/BS degree with emphasis on a quantitative discipline (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Operations Research) required; advanced degree (MS or PhD) in a quantitative or applied science strongly preferred.
- 10+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or applied analytics, including substantial hands-on ownership of model development and production machine learning systems.
- 5+ years of experience leading and developing data science or machine learning talent, with a demonstrated ability to build and mentor high-performing teams while remaining hands-on.
- Demonstrated experience building, deploying, and operating machine learning or optimization systems in production, with accountability across the full lifecycle from design through deployment, monitoring, and retraining.
- Demonstrated success applying predictive, prescriptive, forecasting, optimization, and segmentation methods to complex business problems.

Technical Skills
- Strong hands-on proficiency in SQL and Python (experience with R or other languages a plus).
- Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure) and modern data technologies (e.g., Snowflake, Spark, or Databricks).
- Expertise in data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau; Datorama a plus).
- Experience accessing various APIs and scripting refresh/update and ETL/ELT processes.
- Experience analyzing and assessing marketing channel performance—including digital ads, Google Ads, Facebook, and web analytics—a plus.

Other Requirements
- Demonstrated success using performance-based / ROI analysis to drive decisions and recommendations for resident and business strategy.
- Excellent verbal and written communication, with a proven ability to explain analytical concepts and results to senior business leaders.
- Demonstrated experience analyzing customer behavior and creating customer segmentation.
- Strong business judgment and the ability to shape strategy and lead cross-functional prioritization.
- Ability to be at work on a regular and consistent basis.

Why Invitation Homes
We believe when our residents thrive, our associates thrive. Here, you're not just filling a role — you're building a career at a company that invests in your growth and welcomes you for who you are.

What's in it for you

jobs.description:
Our Mission
ButterflyMX is on a mission to empower people to automate property access, operations, and security from a single platform. Our products are installed in more than 23,000+ multifamily, commercial, gated communities, and student-housing properties worldwide, including properties developed, owned, and managed by the most trusted names in real estate. Our features are designed for developers, owners, property managers, and tenants and our products lower operating costs and improve tenant satisfaction.

Our Solution
Developers and owners no longer need to run building wiring or install in-unit hardware. Property managers can grant building access, revoke permissions, and review entry logs from an online dashboard. Residents can open doors from their smartphones, issue visitor access, and see who is trying to enter the building.

Our Culture & Values
Fantastic people are the key to our success. As a distributed, primarily remote workforce, we’re looking for more intelligent, passionate, collaborative, AI-forward, and down-to-earth individuals to join our growing team. We’re driven by a shared commitment to excellence and innovation, grounded in our core values: We delight our customers, We take ownership, We are a community of collaborators, We speak up, We think big and do small, and We are tenacious.

Role Overview
ButterflyMX is hiring for a Principal PM to lead the mobile product experience for a new and growing area of our business. You’ll own the mobile experience for this new surface area while solving the needs of property managers and operators who are part of the same ecosystem. This is a role for someone who can hit the ground running with existing momentum and still bring the curiosity and rigor to challenge what we think we know.

- Conduct rigorous discovery by getting close to end users and operators, sharpening the problem definition while iterating with Design and Engineering on the solution

- Embed AI into the product where it creates genuine value, not as a feature checkbox but as a lever for better experiences and smarter operations

- Make smart calls about what we build versus partner versus white-label

- Establish the metrics that matter and hold yourself accountable to them

Requirements
- 7+ years in product management with a track record of owning products from concept to market

- Mobile-first instincts: you think in mobile experiences natively, understand what makes a consumer app sticky, and have shipped products people use on their phones

- Comfort with ambiguity and early-stage product challenges: you can operate with a partial playbook, fill in the gaps, and make confident decisions with incomplete information

- Strong discovery discipline: you know how to get close to customers, synthesize qualitative signal, and translate it into a clear product direction

- AI-native thinking: you approach product problems by asking how intelligent systems can improve the experience, not by adding AI as an afterthought. You stay current on what the technology can actually do, and you bring that knowledge into discovery, design, and prioritization conversations

- A builder’s mindset: you don’t just write specs and hand them off. You prototype, tinker, use the tools available to you today to explore ideas quickly, and you close the loop between what you ask engineering to build and how it actually works

- Sharp communication skills: you can influence across engineering, design, go-to-market, and leadership by writing well, presenting clearly, and earning trust without authority

Bonus if you have at least one
- Experience in proptech, multifamily real estate, or property operations

- Experience building consumer mobile apps with meaningful engagement, retention, or marketplace dynamics

- Experience navigating third-party integrations or white-label partnerships as part of a product strategy

- Background in platforms where the end user and the buyer are different people: you understand that tension and know how to build for both

Compensation
The expected base salary range for this position is $200,000-$240,000. Actual compensation will depend on factors including budget, skills, experience, location, and internal equity. This position may also be eligible for bonuses, equity, or other forms of compensation, where applicable.

- And more!

jobs.title: Product Lead, Visitors
jobs.summary: Envoy protects the places the world relies on most by unifying people, spaces, and communications in one secure, integrated workplace management platform and ecosystem.
jobs.description:
Envoy protects the places the world relies on most by unifying people, spaces, and communications in one secure, integrated workplace management platform and ecosystem. More than 16,000 workplaces around the world trust Envoy to run secure, compliant, and connected operations across every location.

From manufacturing sites and data centers to pharmaceutical labs, healthcare facilities, and corporate headquarters, Envoy makes safety, security and associated regulatory compliance something our customers can be proud of. The industry is littered with box-checking and arcane manual processes as the standard and we see our role as the company to bring experience, efficiency and simplicity everywhere. Great experiences bring great security – it's a requirement. We hope this problem space excites you and we hope you're ready to come sweat the details with us – we have a lot of customers counting on us! And it certainly won't be easy.

Learn more at envoy.com

About the Role: Product management here at Envoy is the most critical role in ensuring customers and their end-users love the products they use. Every decision you make will directly impact tens of thousands of workplaces around the world and their millions of occupants, be them employees, visitors, contractors, etc. Envoy seeks to deliver next-level operational efficiency, data-drivenness, safety, and security for everyone involved, and our solutions must be highly thoughtful about this at scale. You will be responsible for this for your product or product line. This isn't an easy job, but if high stakes is your game, you'll enjoy things a lot.

We are currently looking for a product leader to own and evolve a large portion of Envoy Visitors, our flagship visitor management platform used by companies all around the world. Visitors is very powerful – customers are using it to meet strict regulatory compliances in their industries. They need to do background checks to make sure people aren't from sanctioned countries, they are requiring specific OSHA trainings of their contractors, they need full audit logs of all changes over hundreds of facilities, they need to provision access control credentials for specific vendors, there's a lot going on and at scale. What you'll be working on is absolutely critical to the safety and security of their operations so thoughtfulness is critical every day. There’s a lot of surface area, a lot of different customer needs, and a lot of opportunity to make big industry-changing decisions. It's what they've been waiting for.

We're currently a small and nimble product team looking to grow from leadership previously being spread throughout product design roles, product marketing, engineering management, and we even have some IC engineers running their products externally. Needless to say, we recognize this isn't going to scale, and we want to get ahead of it with your ownership and help. This brings inward opportunity too – as the product team grows, we'll need product line leaders and organizers, and we'd much rather promote from within when possible. But for now, this is an IC PM role as that's the immediate need.

This is a full-time, 5-day onsite role in San Francisco (410 Townsend St). Please remember we are a workplace company. We build products for workplaces and we believe that we can only become experts in something when we surround ourselves in it! We're happy to help move you out here if necessary. We also help with visa transfers if needed.

We hope this all sounds great to you so far!

As a baseline, you will need
- 5+ years of experience in Product Management, preferably in B2B with enterprise exposure and 0-1 product building experience

- An undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a quantitative field

In this role, you will
- Meticulously own vision, roadmap, strategy, and execution of your products

- Launch products and be ultimately responsible for the success/failure of the products/features based on the goals/metrics you define.

- Push for quality and urgency despite constant challenges for one or the other. You need to enjoy this battle.

- Be the primary switchboard and gather feedback from customers directly, our sales/success teams, and others cross-functionally to create an opinion and get things iterated, built, and launched. You must be good at rational decision-making; not everyone will always agree, yet you'll still need their support.

- Be the point person to customers during beta or high-iteration periods in products. And you'll run internal dogfooding.

- Story-tell internally the importance of what we're building to engineering ICs, designers, researchers and the general company, encouraging bottoms up ownership, creative thinking and internal contribution.

- Own much of pricing and packaging, and you'll ensure sales training happens as you expect for your products. There is no throwing-over-the-wall allowed here.

- You'll bring your existing product processes and help us all elevate our product execution.

- And yes, it has to be said, roles change over time; this job description is dynamic, you need to be comfortable in an environment where things can change a lot.

Your values: Every company is unique, with its own culture and community, and specific values that make things gel. There is no one general fingerprint for what makes a 'good' company or a 'bad' one, it's all dependent on your personal values and how well they map to the values of the company you're part of. It's therefore critical you and us match well together. As you explore the list below, please be real with yourself – is this the kind of environment you really want? If not "yes absolutely", it's best to not apply, trust us, you're going to have a bad time. If however, these describe you, you're going to have an amazing time here with friends you'll retain for years to come. We hope this describes you!
- You have a passion for workplaces, have strong end-user intuition and demand products you yourself can proudly use daily

- You thrive in ambiguous, low-guidance environments. You seek accountability and to own the success (and failure!) of everything you work on.

- You have a high bar for everything you build, including the way it looks and feels, spending the time necessary to achieve quality to winning standards. Especially in Enterprise software, notorious for putting quality by the wayside.

- You create and hold yourself and your team to success metrics. You are data-driven, relying on numbers to persuade versus necessarily just high-paying customer anecdotes.

- You are impatient and expect things sooner than in a couple weeks, months or quarters

- You have high empathy and humility and understand you're always learning. You're also aggressively a believer that everyone you work with must be this way too.

- You rely on AI tooling and truly see it as a massive force multiplier and you are excited about constantly evolving yourself to best reap its benefits. You are also excited to share the AI discoveries that you're continuously making (and you expect the same of your peers too).

- You believe teams being in-office are the best way to solve problems fast and build great products.

- You look for all these same values from your current and future teammates and would be disappointed and even consider departing if we compromised too often. You want to be part of a like-minded team and culture.

Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Envoy to process your application. Envoy is an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by local, state or federal law.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Invitation Homes is a team of more than 1,700 associates who come from all walks of life. We call different communities “home," but our shared values bind us together. Invitation Homes is a place where possibility lives.

The market teams include our Leasing, Property Management and Rehab, Turns & Maintenance professionals. Your Role on the Team

As a Director, Rehab, Turns & Maintenance (RTM Director) is responsible for adherence to property-level expense budgets, ensuring that RTM associates are properly trained to perform their role and comply with all company and department policies, establishing and maintaining resident “genuine care” standards and holding market RTM associates and vendors accountable to established operating standards. This includes but is not limited to the following tasks:

- Communicating all projected, unfavorable budget variances to local and national team leaders to ensure awareness of projected financial challenges

- Reviewing and approving all necessary projects ensuring scope and pricing are appropriate.

- Ensuring adherence to all Invitation Homes processes and procedures while maintaining a superior resident experience

- Periodically inspecting homes in turn/rehab process to assure quality standards are being achieved

- Working with property management team members to resolve significant resident complaints and ensuring that excellent customer service is being offered to residents

jobs.title: Associate General Counsel

jobs.summary: About Orchard Orchard is transforming the way people buy and sell their homes. Simplifying it, to the way it should have always been; fair and true to market, straightforward, easy…
jobs.description:
About Orchard

Orchard is transforming the way people buy and sell their homes. Simplifying it, to the way it should have always been; fair and true to market, straightforward, easy. Every year in the U.S., $1.5 trillion of single family homes transact, generating over $120 billion of fees in a process that has changed little in decades. For the average American, the home purchase and sale process takes months, creates anxiety and is filled with uncertainty and hassle. Orchard offers a modern alternative, making one of life's biggest decisions -- the sale and purchase of a home –so stress free, fair and simple that people cannot imagine any other way. Orchard is headquartered in New York City, has 150+ employees, a network of 600 agents and has grown nearly 2x year over the last 2 years. We have raised equity financing from top tier investors including: Firstmark, Accomplice, Revolution Growth, Navitas and Juxtapose.

About the Role

Orchard is looking for an Associate General Counsel to join our dynamic and quickly expanding team. As the third member of the Legal & Regulatory team, you are ready to roll up your sleeves and make an immediate impact. You will play a key role in our rapidly growing business, partnering with teams across the company to help build and evolve our product offerings, expand to new jurisdictions, and further develop and mature our business lines, all while balancing business objectives and legal risk across the multiple highly-regulated sectors in which we operate. You will work across all of our business units and make meaningful contributions to each. And as the company continues to grow, there is significant opportunity to take on additional responsibilities and leadership roles.

The ideal candidate is a highly self-motivated, business-minded attorney who enjoys operating autonomously, successfully navigates ambiguity, and can manage multiple projects and competing priorities comfortably. This person brings extraordinary judgment and interpersonal skills to the role. While highly effective and an innovative thinker, you take a humble approach to your job, allowing your work to speak for itself. By building a track record of sound advice and success, you will become a trusted advisor to senior leadership and teams across the company. We are looking for candidates who are excited about the opportunity to help grow Orchard’s business in an entrepreneurial yet compliant manner, while working with diverse groups of stakeholders to get things done in a complex and fast moving environment.

This is a full-time role that will report to the General Counsel and will be based out of our New York City office. We are on a hybrid schedule, in office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. While our preference is for New York based candidates, we may be open to candidates in one of the following areas: Washington DC, CA, CO, FL, GA, MA, MI, MS, NC, NJ, NY, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, or WA.

What You’ll Do Here

- Act as a legal swiss-army knife, working independently across several different legal practice areas, but with a particular focus on commercial and regulatory issues and building out Orchard’s products and services in compliance with the legal and regulatory frameworks governing residential real estate.

- Act as the go-to person for Orchard’s commercial partnerships. From inception to execution, you will have a seat at the table and will drive deals independently.

- Assist our mortgage company to build out that company’s product and service offerings and delivery, as well as policies, controls, and structure to be compliant with applicable federal and state legal frameworks, while also taking a leadership role in expanding its reach into additional states.

- Work with our title companies to help innovate, streamline and create customer delight in the delivery of those companies’ services, all while maintaining compliance with applicable state laws and regulations.

- Partner with our Product & Engineering Teams to design and iterate how our products and services are provided to customers, helping to intelligently balance innovation and growth with legal and regulatory risk.

- Engage with and build relationships with state regulators, in particular in connection with expansion of our businesses into new states, our ongoing operational compliance, and any regulatory inquiries or examinations that may arise.

- Manage outside law firms across a variety of practice areas, while balancing cost and effectiveness in the delivery of legal services to our stakeholders.

- Contribute to the continued development and improvement of our Data Privacy and Information Security policies, practices and procedures.

- You also may have the opportunity to be involved in both equity and debt financings, involving both venture capital as well as traditional debt and equity capital providers.

We’d Love to Hear From You if You

- Are a broad-based attorney with at least 7 years of experience in the commercial and/or regulatory space, gained ideally through a combination of law firm and in-house roles of increasing visibility and responsibility.

- Have solid experience with commercial contracts, whether negotiating from a commercial perspective or reviewing from a regulatory perspective, including leading negotiations or discussions with large companies.

- Ideally have experience with the laws and regulatory frameworks governing residential real estate, mortgage lending, title insurance, and settlement services, including RESPA, TILA, the Fair Housing Act, ECOA, GLBA, and applicable state licensing and regulatory requirements.

- Have experience navigating the application of evolving and sometimes overlapping regulations in a business context.

- Are an entrepreneur who sees ambiguity as opportunity, and obstacles as chances to build new solutions.

- Can successfully work independently with little guidance, but also to use good judgment and escalate issues when needed.

- Are eager to collaborate and comfortable and effective at building strong relationships with people across a variety of functional teams, skill sets and levels of professional experience.

- Have a demonstrated drive for results, work ethic and ability to prioritize risks and projects to focus on what’s important, get things done, and seize opportunities.

- Have meticulous attention to detail and excellent planning and organization skills.

- Have experience with Data Privacy regimes and implementation of the related policies and procedures, though this is by no means required.

- Have a state bar admission in good standing.

The pay range for this position in New York City is $225K–$260K. The actual base pay offered may vary within the range provided depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Stock options and other incentive pay may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, depending on the position offered. This information is provided per the New York City Human Rights Law. Please note that the range provided is applicable only to New York City-based applicants. Base compensation may vary if the work location is outside of New York City.
Orchard is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law.
