jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.summary: The U.S. mortgage market is a $14 trillion pillar of the economy — and much of it still runs on fax machines, overnight shipping, and manual workflows. Snapdocs is changing that.
jobs.description:
The U.S. mortgage market is a $14 trillion pillar of the economy — and much of it still runs on fax machines, overnight shipping, and manual workflows. Snapdocs is changing that. Our platform currently powers 20% of all real estate closings in the country, and we’re just getting started.
We design workflow software and AI-driven automation that connects lenders, settlement teams, notaries, and investors — eliminating friction, reducing risk, and delivering a faster, simpler closing for every borrower. Our customers range from the largest mortgage lenders to independent title companies. They trust us because we solve real operational pain with empathy, rigor, and reliability.
We’re backed by Sequoia, Y Combinator, and F-Prime, and we’re building for the long term.
Why this role exists
Snapdocs is the trusted infrastructure for high-stakes transactions. We started in mortgage, where trust is not assumed, the work is fragmented across many parties, and the cost of mistakes is real - and are bringing that same standard of trust to other markets.
Years of automating the hardest tasks gave us something more foundational than workflow software: an AI-native platform that makes complex work easy to complete, hard to get wrong, and built to withstand scrutiny over time.
Field marketing turns that promise into tangible presence and relationships in the market by owning the programs that put Snapdocs in front of the right audiences, in the right settings, for the right reasons. You’ll turn conferences, executive programs, customer gatherings, partner activations, and account-based programs into credible brand experiences, tight relationships, and measurable commercial impact.

The role
This is a hands-on field marketing role with broad ownership. You’ll help shape where and why Snapdocs shows up, choose the programs most relevant to our audiences and business priorities, manage the details that make those programs work, and connect every program to coordinated Sales and Marketing follow-up.
Events are the primary channel, but field marketing is broader than event execution. It also includes regional programs, executive presence, customer and prospect engagement, partner programs, and account-based plays across Snapdocs’ markets. You’ll help make our mission tangible by creating experiences that simplify complexity, build trust, and move the right relationships forward.

What you'll own
- Take ownership of a strong, existing events lineup for mortgage, primarily geared towards sales in-person meetings, and then building the playbook for expanding event presence on-stage, in new thought-leadership forums and through field motions.

- Strategize a new non-real-estate events plan, including identifying strategic event and field motions in priority adjacent industries, designed to establish credibility, develop relationships, and create pipeline in those markets.

- Unify existing and new vertical field marketing strategies into a tiered event strategy across industry, partner, customer, and executive programs.

- Decide the right level of presence for each program, from attendance and executive meetings to sponsorships, booths, speaking opportunities, roundtables, dinners, and roadshows.

- Run event programs end to end: goals, budget, registrations, vendors, booth and materials, attendee lists, on-site execution, and follow-up.

- Partner with Lender and Settlement Sales to connect event plans to target accounts, meetings, and next steps, ensuring event participation converts into a repeatable pipeline and revenue motion, strengthens Snapdocs’ credibility across the mortgage ecosystem and new verticals, and builds executive, partner, and customer relationships that support growth

- Work with Revenue Marketing on pre-event outreach, in-event signal capture, and post-event follow-up, including help with prospecting, messaging and social engagement.

- Use HubSpot as the system of record for event planning, lists, activity tracking, and handoffs, with Salesforce and Slack connected where needed.

- Track cost per attendee, meetings booked, meeting follow-up, qualified opportunities, pipeline impact, and 30-day post-event ROI. Use what you learn to make sharper investment calls.

What we're looking for
- 4+ years of field marketing, event marketing, or go-to-market marketing experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, financial services, or a similarly complex industry.

- A track record of owning events or field programs that contributed to qualified meetings, pipeline, customer relationships, or revenue.

- Excellent project management. You keep many workstreams moving, write clear next steps, and make it obvious who owns what and when.

- Strong judgment on event investment. You can assess attendee lists, audience fit, sponsorship value, sales goals, cost, and expected return before recommending a program.

- Experience working closely with sales, customers, partners, vendors, and executives. You make it easy for others to do their part and keep things from falling through the cracks.

- Comfort learning and operating marketing automation, CRM, lead capture, or event systems. Direct HubSpot experience is a plus.

- Experience working on a lean marketing team with broad ownership, from deciding where to invest to making sure the room is ready.

- Ability to travel to industry events, customer programs, and executive gatherings. Travel will be dependent on the specific event needs, but this role is not required to be at every event, instead using good judgment and clear evaluation of need to determine on-site presence levels.

AI proficiency at Snapdocs
AI proficiency is a core expectation at Snapdocs. We expect you to use AI as part of your day-to-day work, with real judgment about where it helps and where you need to check the output.

For this role, that might include researching events, organizing event data, drafting outreach or briefs, building repeatable planning workflows, and connecting systems for regular check-ins and next steps for supporting partners. You should be curious about new uses, able to explain what changed in your work, and willing to verify what AI produces before it reaches a customer or sales team.

Compensation and benefits
We believe in being upfront about pay. The base salary range for this role is as follows:
- $131,000 - $150,000

Where you land within the range depends on your experience, skills, and how you'll make an impact in the role. In addition to base salary and variable compensation, this position includes meaningful equity and a comprehensive benefits package.
Why Snapdocs
We’re here to transform one of the most critical and complex industries in the world. That requires a team that is curious, driven, thoughtful, and practical. We value:
- Product discipline and clear reasoning

- Deep ownership of outcomes (not just tasks)

- Straightforward, honest communication

- Empathy for the people who use our software

This is a place for people who want to solve hard, meaningful problems with real economic impact — not just ship features.

Join Us
We’re expanding our product suite and the network it connects. To do that, we need people who are excited by complexity, energized by scale, and motivated to make a tangible dent in how the mortgage ecosystem works. If you’re hungry to learn, build, and lead — you’ll do the best work of your career here.
To support our team, we offer a comprehensive & thoughtful benefits package for all full-time employees, which includes:
- Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage

- 401(k) with up to 4% company match

- 16 weeks of paid parental leave

- Flexible Paid Vacation Time Off + 10 Sick Days for exempt roles

- Generous Accrued Paid Vacation Time Off + 10 sick days for non-exempt roles

- Summer & Winter Break (~1-week each) + 9 Holidays per year

- Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA

- HSA Employer Contribution ($75-150 for individuals, $150-$250 for families)

- $15K Family Building Benefit (lifetime limit)

- Life and Disability Insurance

- $1,500 Annual Lifestyle Stipend to support your well-being

Please note: Part-time employees are not eligible for benefits at this time
Snapdocs is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.summary: If you’re good at what you do, you can work anywhere. If you’re the best at what you do, come work for Doma Technology.
jobs.description:
If you’re good at what you do, you can work anywhere. If you’re the best at what you do, come work for Doma Technology.

About Us 

Doma Technology LLC offers solutions for lenders, real estate professionals, title agents, and homeowners that make closings vastly simpler and more efficient, reducing cost and increasing customer satisfaction.

Our Values

- Obsessively Entrepreneurial - We encourage calculated risk-taking, and we know that some of our best learning happens by making mistakes along the way.

- People First - We communicate with honesty and respect to our customers, colleagues, and partners.

- Better Together - We believe diversity, equity and inclusion creates value through the differences in our backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

- Act with Integrity - We hold ourselves to the highest ethical standards in all of our business practices.

Doma is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to own and evolve Looker, the business intelligence platform our Operations teams rely on for real-time, day-to-day reporting — SLAs, exception management, escalations, hands-on time reporting, turnaround times, vendor management, and more. You’ll be the primary point of contact for Looker across the company: owning the connectivity between Snowflake and our other source data and Looker end-to-end, building and maintaining the dashboards that keep Operations running, safeguarding data quality and provenance, and partnering with Finance, Data Science, and other business units on their reporting needs. We’re also looking for someone excited about what comes next — ideally with experience building or working hands-on with AI/agentic reporting tools — to help us build an agentic reporting layer on that same underlying data so business users can self-serve ad hoc questions that don't require long term dashboards.

You're fired up to:
• Use your raw data analysis intuition to revolutionize a 150-year-old industry
• Own, build, and maintain the Looker dashboards and data models that Operations, Finance, and Data Science depend on every day
• Own the connectivity between Snowflake and other source data and Looker — the pipelines, data models, and integrations that keep our reporting layer accurate and current end-to-end
• Be the primary point of contact for Looker company-wide — fielding requests, triaging issues, and setting standards for how dashboards get built
• Oversee data quality and data provenance across our reporting layer
• Play a key role in day-to-day operational decision-making — SLAs, exception management, escalations, hands-on time reporting, turnarounds, and vendor management — through rapid delivery of insights
• Design and help build an agentic reporting layer on top of our existing data — working hands-on with AI reporting agents so business users can self-serve ad hoc requests instead of filing a ticket

Funnel Leasing Inc., is hiring for a Strategy & Operations Manager, AI. The Strategy & Operations Manager, AI is responsible for driving the strategic direction and go-to-market strategy for Funnel’s cutting-edge AI products, becoming the accountable party for the segment’s P&L. Collaborating closely with customers of all sizes, you'll gain valuable insights into their AI strategies, ensuring seamless alignment of Funnel’s products with their unique needs and Funnel’s overarching goals. Your role will involve conducting research to pinpoint trends, customer preferences, and competitive dynamics that will inform Funnel’s corporate strategy and product roadmap. With ownership of Funnel’s pricing and packaging strategies, you'll strike the balance between product value, market demand, and profit margin. You will have the responsibility of leading and elevating the future of Funnel’s AI-driven solutions while improving the country’s rental experience. The Salary range for this role is $125,000 to $145,000/year.
Why Funnel?
We are a 'work from anywhere' in the U.S. SaaS company that centers our services on the renter experience. We develop amazing software that has revolutionized the #proptech industry. And did we mention we have an amazing team that is on #FunnelFire!? Oh, did we forget to tell you we have unlimited PTO, benefits that begin on your first day of employment, P.I.N.K. core values that ROCK, and our team puts the FUN in Funnel!
Who is Funnel Leasing?
Have you ever rented an apartment and wished the process could be better? At Funnel we do too. We know we need to make the process of renting an apartment as easy as purchasing socks on Amazon. We’ve created cloud-based marketing and leasing software that delivers the ultimate rental experience for everyone involved in the process. We’re in the process of transforming the real estate industry through cutting-edge technology built, sold, and supported by the most passionate people you’ll meet.

The Strategy & Operations Manager, AI essential roles and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

Roles and responsibilities
- Lead the strategy and GTM approach for Funnel’s AI products (VLA, VVLA, MA, & new AI offerings/integrations).
- Track and analyze financial data to make informed decisions regarding resource allocation, investment opportunities, and cost optimization, being accountable for the financial success of Funnel’s AI segment P&L (Will work with Finance to create a P&L).
- Take ownership of pricing and packaging strategies in collaboration with sales/marketing, optimizing them to reflect product value and market demands, with the goal of maximizing margins where possible.
- Conduct market research to identify trends, customer preferences, and competitive dynamics which you will use to inform Funnel’s product and strategy decisions.
- Collaborate with customers of all sizes (e.g., Enterprise, Mid-Market) to gain insights into their AI strategies; ensuring that our products are aligned with their needs / objectives.
- Drive the evaluation between off-the-shelf and proprietary AI solutions, considering the dynamic landscape of the industry.
- Be the connective tissue between product/engineering, revenue, and CX regarding Funnel’s AI related products and strategy.
- Strategically engage in select sales engagements to accelerate segment attachment, overall ARR growth, and increase the percentage of Funnel ARR from the segment.
- Manage various product marketing initiatives around Funnel’s suite of AI products, ensuring Funnel is successfully selling the value of the products (throughout marketing/sales lifecycle) and bringing new AI products to market.
- Engage with executive leadership, department heads, and external stakeholders to harmonize product strategies with overarching organizational goals.
- Travel:
Education, Work Experience, and Certifications
- 3+ years of experience in strategy consulting, investment banking/private equity, AND/OR a top-tier tech company in strategy, business operations, or growth.
- Proven track record of running cross-functional initiatives, achieving goals, and succeeding in a team environment
- Strong problem-solving, analytical, and interpersonal skills.
- Passion to do whatever it takes to solve complex problems and build scalable processes.
- Comfort working in a high growth, constantly changing environment

You'll really impress us if you have:
- A JD or MBA
- Experience in the real estate industry
- Experience at a SaaS company.
- Knowledge of and interest in artificial intelligence.
- An obsession with challenging the status quo.

Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Funnel, we are committed to building a proptech company that is as diverse as the multifamily industry we serve, and that means to not only live our inclusivity, but also to support and encourage it among all of society. If you are excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.
Equal Employment Opportunity

Funnel may change the specific job duties with or without prior notice based on the needs of the organization.

Benefits

 - Term Life insurance

In addition to these benefits, we also offer

jobs.title: GTM Recruiter
jobs.summary: Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annu…
jobs.description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

About the Role
Our Client Success org is the reason agents stay with Luxury Presence. Client Success Managers, Client Experience Specialists, Onboarding Specialists, and Client Support Representatives are the people our customers talk to every week, and we are hiring a lot of them in Scottsdale and Austin.
This seat comes with real ownership from day one. You will run searches across our client-facing teams, and the mix shifts with what the business needs that quarter. Some months you are closing a cohort of one role. Other months you are deep on Client Success Manager or Client Experience searches. You will own a good share of that work outright, from kickoff through offer, and partner with a senior recruiter on the searches that call for it.
If you want to do full-cycle recruiting at a company hiring at real pace, and you would rather be measured on numbers than on effort, this is a strong seat.
What You'll Do
Own your searches
Run reqs full-cycle across our client-facing teams, from kickoff through offer.
Close 5 to 6 a month at or under a 30-day time to fill.
Run the intake with the hiring manager, set the bar, and hold it.
Partner across the org
Source and screen into the searches you do not own so the funnel never runs dry.
Hand a senior recruiter a slate they can work from, and stay close through the close.
Flex with the mix. The roles you carry will change quarter to quarter as hiring plans move.
Sourcing
Find client-facing talent that does not come to us through inbound, using Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, and local channels in Scottsdale and Austin.
Write outreach in your own voice, test what works, and keep the messages that earn replies.
Deliver 60 or more qualified sourced candidates a month across the reqs you touch.
Screening
Run 15 to 20 candidate screens a week.
Screen against what each role actually requires. Work from the hiring manager's intake and the scorecard, know what good looks like before you take the first call, and be able to defend why someone made the slate.
Submit a first slate of 5 to 6 approved candidates within 10 business days of every intake you own.
Candidate experience and process
Respond to every candidate within 24 hours and schedule the next step within 48 hours of a hiring manager decision.
Keep Lever current daily so anyone can see where a search stands.
Deliver a weekly pipeline snapshot to your hiring manager.
What We're Looking For
Skills and Experience
Full-cycle recruiting or sourcing experience, at any depth. We are just as interested in someone a few years into the craft as someone running their first reqs.
Alternatively, a track record in high-volume people work such as client success, support, onboarding, sales development, or hospitality, plus a real reason for wanting to move into recruiting.
Comfort with high volume. You have held a role where the number of conversations you had each week was the point.
Clear, quick writing. You will send a lot of outreach and a lot of candidate updates.
Familiarity with an ATS or CRM. Lever experience helps and is not required.
No degree requirement.
Attributes
Coachable. You take direct feedback, apply it the same week, and ask for help early instead of quietly stalling.
Organized. You keep 20 or more candidates in flight without dropping anyone, using a system rather than memory.
Warm and direct. Candidates remember how you treated them, including the ones who do not get an offer.
Comfortable supporting as well as owning. Some of these searches are yours and some are not, and both matter.
Adaptable. The hiring plan moves, and the roles you carry move with it.
Curious about the craft. You want to get good at recruiting, not just get through the week.
Comfortable in a hybrid seat. This role is in office three days a week in Scottsdale or Austin.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.summary: About Orchard Orchard is transforming the way people buy and sell their homes. Simplifying it, to the way it should have always been; fair and true to market, straightforward, easy…
jobs.description:
About Orchard

Orchard is transforming the way people buy and sell their homes. Simplifying it, to the way it should have always been; fair and true to market, straightforward, easy. Every year in the U.S., $1.5 trillion of single family homes transact, generating over $120 billion of fees in a process that has changed little in decades. For the average American, the home purchase and sale process takes months, creates anxiety and is filled with uncertainty and hassle. Orchard offers a modern alternative, making one of life's biggest decisions -- the sale and purchase of a home –so stress free, fair and simple that people cannot imagine any other way. Orchard is headquartered in New York City, has 150+ employees, a network of 600 agents and has grown nearly 2x year over the last 2 years. We have raised equity financing from top tier investors including: Firstmark, Accomplice, Revolution Growth, Navitas and Juxtapose.

About the Role

Orchard is looking for a Chief Financial Officer to lead our finance organization through the next chapter of profitable growth. As CFO, you'll be a critical member of the leadership team and operating thought partner to CEO Court Cunningham, managing our FP&A, Strategic Finance, and Accounting teams to drive commercially savvy business insight, disciplined budgeting, and accurate forecasting. You'll help build a culture that balances high growth with financial discipline and intelligent risk-taking, while partnering closely with other departments to make them successful. Orchard is approaching profitability in Q4 2026, and we're looking for a CFO who can guide the company into our next chapter of growth.

This is a full-time role that will report into the CEO and be based out of our growing New York City office. We are also open to a remote role for candidates who are based in Denver, CO or Austin, TX.

What You'll Do Here:

- Manage and develop the FP&A, Strategic Finance, and Accounting teams (8 people) to deliver business insight and rigorous financial analysis

- Build and sustain a culture of financial discipline that supports both high growth and profitability

- Foster a culture of intelligent, calculated risk-taking across the organization

- Partner with other departments and functions to support their success

- Serve as a champion for Orchard in the market, helping shape workplace culture in line with Orchard's values

- Lead the company's path toward profitable, sustainable growth.

We'd Love to Hear From You if You Have:

- At least 10+ years of success in financial leadership roles

- Systems thinking, with the ability to lead teams through a combination of personal leadership and process discipline

- An investor's mindset — able to zoom out to the bigger picture and zoom into granular detail, all through a financial lens

- An entrepreneurial approach — high energy, action-oriented, and effective in scrappy, fast-moving environments

- Strong customer focus and empathy, plus intellectual curiosity and comfort making decisions under uncertainty

- M&A experience (a plus, not required)

- A reputation as a passionate leader and strong communicator who gets things done

The pay range for this position in New York City is $300K–$375K (combination of base + bonus). The actual base pay offered may vary within the range provided depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Stock options and other incentive pay may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, depending on the position offered. This information is provided per the New York City Human Rights Law. Please note that the range provided is applicable only to New York City-based applicants. Base compensation may vary if the work location is outside of New York City.
Orchard is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law.

jobs.title: Channel Sales Territory Manager
jobs.summary: Our Mission ButterflyMX is on a mission to empower people to automate property access, operations, and security from a single platform.
jobs.description:
Our Mission
ButterflyMX is on a mission to empower people to automate property access, operations, and security from a single platform. Our products are installed in more than 20,000+ multifamily, commercial, gated communities, and student-housing properties worldwide, including properties developed, owned, and managed by the most trusted names in real estate. Our features are designed for developers, owners, property managers, and tenants and our products lower operating costs and improve tenant satisfaction.

Our Solution
Developers and owners no longer need to run building wiring or install in-unit hardware. Property managers can grant building access, revoke permissions, and review entry logs from an online dashboard. Residents can open doors from their smartphones, issue visitor access, and see who is trying to enter the building.

Our Culture & Values
Fantastic people are the key to our success. As a distributed, primarily remote workforce, we’re looking for more intelligent, passionate, collaborative, ai-forward, and down-to-earth individuals to join our growing team. We’re driven by a shared commitment to excellence and innovation, grounded in our core values: We delight our customers, We take ownership, We are a community of collaborators, We speak up, We think big and do small, and We are tenacious.

Role Overview
We're seeking a Channel Territory Manager to join our team to own and grow ButterflyMX’s integrator and reseller partner network across the Western territory.
The CTM is a quota-carrying revenue owner. The motion is distinct from direct sales - CTMs do not sell to end customers. They sell ButterflyMX to integrators and dealers, then work with those partners to generate deal flow that would not otherwise exist in the territory.
The ideal candidate is a results-driven professional with a proven channel sales, partner management, and business development background. This position plays a key role in expanding and optimizing ButterflyMX’s partner network. The individual should be skilled in building and nurturing relationships, developing strategic sales plans, and leveraging data-driven insights to drive revenue growth. Experience managing channel partnerships, executing go-to-market strategies, and optimizing sales performance across multiple territories is essential.

Responsibilities
- Own and grow the partner relationship across all tiers (Bronze, Silver, Gold) in the West Coast. Quarterback partner onboarding, deal registration, co-sell support, and quarterly business reviews.

- Run the three core CTM motions: whale hunting (signing Tier 1 integrators not currently in the program), tier progression activation (moving partners up the Bronze/Silver/Gold ladder), and commercial vertical development.

- Identify, pursue, and sign target integrators using project intelligence (ConstructConnect, install history, competitive displacement opportunities). Lead with margin and recurring revenue economics, not product features.

- Build joint business plans with Gold and Silver partners. Run quarterly QBRs that walk partners through their unit economics, software margin trajectory, and pipeline.

- Partner with internal AEs on co-sell motion. Honor deal registration. Maintain attribution discipline in Salesforce.

- Travel in-territory to partner offices, job sites, regional trade shows, and industry events. Roughly 50%.

- Maintain accurate partner records, pipeline, and forecast in Salesforce. Deliver weekly pipeline brief and quarterly territory scorecard to the Director of Channel Sales.

What we’re looking for
The credibility test for this role is the ability to work with integrators and speak their language — P&L, truck rolls, RMR, labor margin, install economics. Prior employment as an installer or integrator is not required. Vendor-side regional sales managers with deep integrator relationships, former AEs at security or access control OEMs, and partner-facing roles in adjacent categories all fit the profile.
The ideal candidate brings as many of the following as possible. Candidates strong on three of the four are competitive:
- Existing integrator relationships in the West Coast territory

- Consultative, relationship-first sales motion. Comfort with multi-quarter partner development cycles.

- CRM discipline. Salesforce fluency, attribution rigor, clean pipeline hygiene.

- Commercial vertical exposure. Experience selling into smaller office, retail, mixed-use, or boutique hospitality deals.

Required Experience
- 3+ years in a quota-carrying channel sales, partner management, or business development role. Security, access control, video surveillance, low-voltage, or IT VAR experience preferred.

- Track record of building and growing partner relationships from Bronze through strategic tier.

- Comfort engaging at all levels of a partner organization, from owner to install tech to CFO.

- Fluency in Salesforce, Excel, and standard business software.

- Ability to work independently, prioritize across competing demands, and operate against quarterly milestones.

- Strong written and verbal communication. Engaging in a partner meeting, disciplined in CRM and email.

- Willing to travel approximately 50% of the time in-territory.

Compensation
The expected base salary range for this position is $90,000 –$100,000. Actual compensation will depend on factors including budget, skills, experience, location, and internal equity. This position may also be eligible for bonuses, equity, or other forms of compensation, where applicable.

Benefits
- Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans (ButterflyMX covers 80% of the cost) starting day 1

- 401(k) plan with a match

- 10 paid holidays, 20 vacation days, 5 sick days, 3 floating holidays

- Basic Life and Accidental Death and Dismemberment Insurance (ButterflyMX covers 100% of the cost)

- Short and Long Term Disability (ButterflyMX covers 100% of the cost)

- Paid Family Leave

- Employee Assistance Program

- Quarterly self-care stipends

- Access to optional benefits including pre-tax flexible healthcare spending accounts (FSA and HSA), Dependent Care FSA, and Commuter Benefits, as well as optional Supplemental Life, AD&D, Hospital Indemnity, Legal, Accident, Critical Illness, Pet, and Personal Liability Insurance

- And more!

ButterflyMX is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. You must have the authorization to work in the US to become an employee. We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates and employees. If you need reasonable accommodations during the application or the recruiting process, please let our recruiting team know.

jobs.description:
Why Better. Why Now.
Better is rebuilding home finance as an AI-native platform—turning a process that once took weeks into something that can happen in seconds.

With over $110B in loans funded and $1.2B+ raised, we operate at real scale while rethinking how homeownership works from the ground up.

The category hasn’t caught up yet. That’s the opportunity.

About Us:
At NEO Home Loans, powered by Better, our mission is clear: redefine your financial journey. We strive to unlock people's full financial potential, providing clarity throughout every step of the loan process. By making lending approachable, we bring transparency and consistency to the financial world, guiding individuals towards decisions that serve their best interests. Our team comprises passionate, talented, and hardworking individuals dedicated to achieving excellence. Join our team and be part of a dynamic company that values innovation, fosters personal growth, and prioritizes a culture of collaboration and excellence.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:
• Loan Application Processing:
o Manage the end-to-end processing of mortgage loan applications, ensuring all
necessary documents are collected and reviewed for accuracy.
o Collaborate with loan officers, underwriters, and processors to facilitate a smooth
and efficient application process.
• Documentation Management:
o Oversee the organization and maintenance of loan files, ensuring compliance with
regulatory standards and company policies.
o Verify and validate all required documents and information provided by clients.
• Client Communication:
o Act as a primary point of contact for clients, providing updates on the status of their
loan applications.
o Address client inquiries and concerns in a timely and professional manner.
• Coordination with Stakeholders:
o Collaborate with internal teams, including underwriting, processing, and closing
departments, to ensure a coordinated and efficient workflow.
o Communicate with external stakeholders, such as real estate agents and title
companies, to coordinate the closing process.
• Compliance and Quality Assurance:

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager, Corporate Systems
jobs.summary: Funnel Leasing Inc., is hiring for a Technical Project Manager, Corporate Systems.
jobs.description:
Funnel Leasing Inc., is hiring for a Technical Project Manager, Corporate Systems. The Technical Project Manager, Corporate Systems is responsible for delivering the technology projects that keep Funnel’s business teams running efficiently. This role is deliberately hybrid and requires employees to work from the company’s Headquarters office in Odessa, Florida a minimum of one day per week. This person will run projects end to end and also serve as the hands-on technical resource who configures, integrates, and administers the corporate systems those projects depend on. Rather than gathering requirements and handing implementation to someone else, the Technical Project Manager owns the outcome, from discovery through configuration, testing, launch, documentation, and adoption.
Project work spans the organization and covers corporate and internal systems, with a strong emphasis on making those systems work together through native integrations, automation platforms, and vendor APIs. This role partners closely with the IT Manager on prioritization, technical standards, security, and compliance. The salary range for this role is $115,000–$135,000 per year.

Location Requirement: This role is open to candidates who currently reside in the Tampa Bay area or surrounding communities. Please note that relocation assistance or reimbursement is not available for this position.

Why Funnel?
We are a 'work from anywhere' in the U.S. SaaS company that centers our services on the renter experience. We develop amazing software that has revolutionized the #proptech industry. And did we mention we have an amazing team that is on #FunnelFire!? Oh, did we forget to tell you we have unlimited PTO, benefits that begin on your first day of employment, P.I.N.K. core values that ROCK, and our team puts the FUN in Funnel!
Who is Funnel Leasing?
Have you ever rented an apartment and wished the process could be better? At Funnel we do too. We know we need to make the process of renting an apartment as easy as purchasing socks on Amazon. We’ve created cloud-based marketing and leasing software that delivers the ultimate rental experience for everyone involved in the process. We’re in the process of transforming the real estate industry through cutting-edge technology built, sold, and supported by the most passionate people you’ll meet.
The Technical Project Manager, Corporate Systems essential roles and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:
Roles and responsibilities
- Own corporate technology projects end to end, including intake, scoping, requirements, timeline, stakeholder communication, testing, launch, and post-implementation support.
- Serve as the primary technical resource on assigned projects, personally performing system configuration, integration, data migration, and testing work.
- Design, build, document, and maintain integrations between corporate systems using native connectors, integration and automation platforms, vendor APIs, webhooks, and file-based transfers.
- Monitor integrations and automations in production, troubleshoot failures, and build appropriate error handling and alerting.
- Partner with business teams across the organization to understand how they work, then configure and integrate the systems they rely on to improve process, productivity, and outcomes.
- Automate manual and repetitive business processes, including employee onboarding and offboarding workflows and account provisioning and deprovisioning in coordination with identity and endpoint management systems.
- Connect corporate systems to the reporting layer and build operational dashboards and reporting that business owners can rely on and maintain.
- Translate business requirements into system requirements, solution designs, and configuration plans, and run discovery and design sessions with stakeholders.
- Maintain a clear intake and prioritization process for corporate project requests, and provide regular status reporting and visibility into the corporate project portfolio.
- Evaluate technology options and recommend solutions to the IT Manager and business stakeholders, including requirements definition, vendor demos, proof of concept work, and a documented comparison of alternatives.
- Ensure changes to corporate systems follow established change management, access control, and audit requirements (SOC 2), and produce the documentation and evidence those controls require.
- Create and maintain system documentation, integration diagrams, runbooks, and administrator and end-user training materials so that solutions remain supportable after launch.
- Provide escalated technical support for the corporate systems and integrations this role implements, and partner with the IT Manager on day-to-day support coverage.
- Identify opportunities to retire redundant tools, reduce manual work, and improve business processes through better system design and automation.
- Liaise with security, DevOps, engineering, and data teams to ensure corporate solutions align with company technical standards.
- Performs other duties as assigned and modified at the manager’s discretion.
- May be expected to work irregular hours to support a distributed workforce across the United States and to complete implementation and cutover work outside of business hours.
- Create a culture of continuous improvement and learning
- Foster collaboration within team and across the company
- Performs other duties as assigned and modified at manager's discretion
- Travel: Location Requirement: Must currently reside in Tampa Bay or surrounding areas

Education, Work Experience, and Certifications
- A high school diploma or GED equivalent is required; a bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field preferred.
- 3-5 years of experience in business systems, IT project management, systems administration, solutions engineering, or a similar role, ideally at a SaaS or technology company.
- Demonstrated track record of delivering system implementations or integration projects end to end while serving as both the project manager and the hands-on implementer.
- Hands-on configuration and administration experience with corporate SaaS platforms; experience with systems such as Salesforce, Jira, Notion, Rippling, and Looker is preferred.
- Experience building integrations between business systems using native connectors, integration and automation platforms, REST APIs, webhooks, or file-based data transfers.
- Working knowledge of identity and access management concepts, including SSO, role-based access, and least-privilege provisioning.
- Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to run multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities and unclear requirements.
- Excellent written communication and documentation habits; this role is expected to leave behind documentation that others can operate from.
- Ability to translate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and to translate business needs into technical solutions.
- Self-starter mindset, with attention to detail and a willingness to “roll up your sleeves” for hands-on configuration and troubleshooting.
- Track record of building trust with business stakeholders and fostering a collaborative, service-oriented culture.
- Light scripting and data skills (e.g., Python, JavaScript, SQL) used to build, debug, or maintain integrations and reporting are a nice to have.
- Experience operating in a compliance-focused environment (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar), including change management and audit evidence practices, is a nice to have.
- Certifications such as Project Management Professional (PMP), CAPM, Scrum, ITIL, or platform administrator certifications (e.g., Salesforce Administrator) are a plus, but not required.

jobs.title: Demand Generation & Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.summary: Funnel Leasing Inc., is hiring for a Demand Generation & Marketing Operations Manager that can 'work from anywhere' in the U.S.
jobs.description:
Funnel Leasing Inc., is hiring for a Demand Generation & Marketing Operations Manager that can 'work from anywhere' in the U.S. The Demand Generation & Marketing Operations Manager will be responsible for turning Funnel's existing enterprise penetration, product market fit, and brand awareness into a repeatable pipeline engine across its small, well-defined market of roughly 1,800 target accounts — segmenting the known universe, understanding customers and personas, building the campaigns and cadences that reactivate warm accounts and nurture net-new ones, and running ABM plays against the highest-value targets. This person will partner closely with an internal resource who owns the technical build of Funnel's lead/account scoring and attribution systems to bring the demand-gen strategy and channel expertise that makes those systems worth having: which signals actually matter, which accounts to prioritize, and what cadence and message reactivates a dormant account or nurtures a net-new one.
This role is ideal for a demand generation professional who is comfortable working within a long, multi-stakeholder sales cycle, understands the importance of disciplined, creative use of organic channels in building pipeline, and can turn thought leadership, a strong industry event presence and user conference, a respected content and podcast library, and organic LinkedIn performance into structured campaigns and cadences. The ideal candidate should be able to use HubSpot and Salesforce daily to execute, segment, and analyze, and translate raw brand and content assets into clear, repeatable demand-gen programs. This is explicitly an organic-first role — paid media is not part of its scope or budget, and success comes from disciplined use of content, events, email, organic social, and outbound cadences rather than media buying. Proving this role can generate new pipeline and regenerate stale pipeline will lead to greater investment in this department and growing a Demand Generation team. The salary range for this role is $130,000 - $150,000 per year.

Why Funnel?
We are a 'work from anywhere' in the U.S. SaaS company that centers our services on the renter experience. We develop amazing software that has revolutionized the #proptech industry. And did we mention we have an amazing team that is on #FunnelFire!? Oh, did we forget to tell you we have unlimited PTO, benefits that begin on your first day of employment, P.I.N.K. core values that ROCK, and our team puts the FUN in Funnel!
Who is Funnel Leasing?
Have you ever rented an apartment and wished the process could be better? At Funnel we do too. We know we need to make the process of renting an apartment as easy as purchasing socks on Amazon. We’ve created cloud-based marketing and leasing software that delivers the ultimate rental experience for everyone involved in the process. We’re in the process of transforming the real estate industry through cutting-edge technology built, sold, and supported by the most passionate people you’ll meet.
The Demand Generation & Marketing Operations Manager essential roles and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:
Roles and responsibilities
Demand Generation & ABM
- Segment and prioritize our ~1,800-account target list into tiers and personas based on prior engagement and current intent, and build the organic campaigns and cadences that match each tier.
- Build and run reactivation campaigns for previously engaged accounts that have gone quiet, timed around our event calendar and content publishing — likely the fastest, highest-probability pipeline available to us.
- Partner with our events team to plan pre- and post-event campaigns for our 3 major industry events and annual user conference, ensuring every attendee and prospect meeting is tracked, scored, and followed up on.
- Collaborate with our content, product marketing, and events team to repackage existing thought leadership, podcast, and event content into structured nurture sequences by persona and buying stage — you're orchestrating assets we've already built, not starting from a blank page.
- Run ABM plays against top-tier accounts using organic and outbound channels — email, LinkedIn, and direct outreach via tools like Clay and Instantly — replacing broad prospecting with precision targeting, without a paid media budget.
- Own and continuously test our cold and warm outbound cadences, partnering with SDRs on message and sequence performance.

Marketing Operations
- Own HubSpot and Salesforce administration for marketing: lead and account scoring models, lifecycle stages, routing rules, and data hygiene between the two systems.
- Build and maintain the campaign and channel attribution reporting that connects marketing activity to Salesforce pipeline and closed-won revenue.
- Design and manage automated nurture and follow-up workflows, including a mandatory post-event follow-up cadence for our SDR team.
- Define and maintain MQL/SQL criteria jointly with Sales leadership, and monitor handoff quality between marketing and the SDR/AE team.
- Evaluate, implement, and operate tools that identify individual and account-level buying intent (e.g., website visitor identification, LinkedIn engagement signals) and feed that signal into scoring and routing.

Reporting & Collaboration
- Report on pipeline generated by channel and campaign, and make the call on what to scale, fix, or kill. • • Partner with Sales leadership on SDR and AE enablement for marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced opportunities.
- Create a culture of continuous improvement and learning
- Foster collaboration within team and across the company
- Performs other duties as assigned and modified at manager's discretion
- Travel:

Education, Work Experience, and Certifications
- 3-5+ years in marketing operations, RevOps, or demand generation with hands-on ownership of a marketing automation platform (HubSpot strongly preferred) and its integration with Salesforce.
- Proven experience building lead/account scoring models, lifecycle stages, and automated nurture workflows from scratch, not just maintaining someone else's setup.
- Experience managing organic email and social/LinkedIn campaigns, including account-based targeting.
- Background in B2B SaaS with a long sales cycle and multiple buying-committee stakeholders strongly preferred (enterprise, security, infrastructure, or similar categories); high-volume PLG/self-serve backgrounds are a less natural fit for this motion.
- Comfortable working from ambiguity, this role is building the system, not maintaining a mature one.
- Strong analytical skills; comfortable pulling and interpreting your own reporting on pipeline and channel performance.
- Clear communicator who can operate independently with a marketing leader who owns overall GTM strategy, while still shaping tactics and pushing back when warranted.

jobs.summary: ***** This role is based in Scottsdale, AZ. Office days are Tue, Wed, and Thur ***** Who We Are We’re building the future of real estate — today.
jobs.description:
***** This role is based in Scottsdale, AZ. Office days are Tue, Wed, and Thur *****

Who We Are

We’re building the future of real estate — today.

HomeLight is the real estate technology platform powering innovative transactions for top agents, lenders, and their clients. Our technology makes it easier to buy and sell homes, whether that's enabling clients to buy before they sell, find a top agent, or have certainty through a modern closing process. Each year, HomeLight facilitates billions of dollars of residential real estate business on its platform for thousands of agents and loan officers. Our vision is a world where every real estate transaction is simple, certain, and satisfying for all.

Our team breaks barriers every day while staying committed to HomeLight's goals and core values, which is a crucial element to our shared success.

What You’ll Do Here

- Review mortgage loan applications for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with lending guidelines.

- Verify and analyze borrower information, including income, employment, credit history, and assets.

- Request and obtain required documentation, such as pay stubs, bank statements, tax returns, and property appraisals.

jobs.summary: Our Mission ButterflyMX is on a mission to empower people to automate property access, operations, and security from a single platform.
jobs.description:
Our Mission
ButterflyMX is on a mission to empower people to automate property access, operations, and security from a single platform. Our products are installed in more than 20,000+ multifamily, commercial, gated communities, and student-housing properties worldwide, including properties developed, owned, and managed by the most trusted names in real estate. Our features are designed for developers, owners, property managers, and tenants and our products lower operating costs and improve tenant satisfaction.

Our Solution
Developers and owners no longer need to run building wiring or install in-unit hardware. Property managers can grant building access, revoke permissions, and review entry logs from an online dashboard. Residents can open doors from their smartphones, issue visitor access, and see who is trying to enter the building.

Our Culture & Values
Fantastic people are the key to our success. As a distributed, primarily remote workforce, we’re looking for more intelligent, passionate, collaborative, ai-forward, and down-to-earth individuals to join our growing team. We’re driven by a shared commitment to excellence and innovation, grounded in our core values: We delight our customers, We take ownership, We are a community of collaborators, We speak up, We think big and do small, and We are tenacious.

Role Overview
We're seeking a Channel Territory Manager to join our team to own and grow ButterflyMX’s integrator and reseller partner network across the Western territory.
The CTM is a quota-carrying revenue owner. The motion is distinct from direct sales - CTMs do not sell to end customers. They sell ButterflyMX to integrators and dealers, then work with those partners to generate deal flow that would not otherwise exist in the territory.
The ideal candidate is a results-driven professional with a proven channel sales, partner management, and business development background. This position plays a key role in expanding and optimizing ButterflyMX’s partner network. The individual should be skilled in building and nurturing relationships, developing strategic sales plans, and leveraging data-driven insights to drive revenue growth. Experience managing channel partnerships, executing go-to-market strategies, and optimizing sales performance across multiple territories is essential.

Responsibilities
- Own and grow the partner relationship across all tiers (Bronze, Silver, Gold) in the West Coast. Quarterback partner onboarding, deal registration, co-sell support, and quarterly business reviews.

- Run the three core CTM motions: whale hunting (signing Tier 1 integrators not currently in the program), tier progression activation (moving partners up the Bronze/Silver/Gold ladder), and commercial vertical development.

- Identify, pursue, and sign target integrators using project intelligence (ConstructConnect, install history, competitive displacement opportunities). Lead with margin and recurring revenue economics, not product features.

- Build joint business plans with Gold and Silver partners. Run quarterly QBRs that walk partners through their unit economics, software margin trajectory, and pipeline.

- Partner with internal AEs on co-sell motion. Honor deal registration. Maintain attribution discipline in Salesforce.

- Travel in-territory to partner offices, job sites, regional trade shows, and industry events. Roughly 50%.

- Maintain accurate partner records, pipeline, and forecast in Salesforce. Deliver weekly pipeline brief and quarterly territory scorecard to the Director of Channel Sales.

What we’re looking for
The credibility test for this role is the ability to work with integrators and speak their language — P&L, truck rolls, RMR, labor margin, install economics. Prior employment as an installer or integrator is not required. Vendor-side regional sales managers with deep integrator relationships, former AEs at security or access control OEMs, and partner-facing roles in adjacent categories all fit the profile.
The ideal candidate brings as many of the following as possible. Candidates strong on three of the four are competitive:
- Existing integrator relationships in the West Coast territory

- Consultative, relationship-first sales motion. Comfort with multi-quarter partner development cycles.

- CRM discipline. Salesforce fluency, attribution rigor, clean pipeline hygiene.

- Commercial vertical exposure. Experience selling into smaller office, retail, mixed-use, or boutique hospitality deals.

Required Experience
- 3+ years in a quota-carrying channel sales, partner management, or business development role. Security, access control, video surveillance, low-voltage, or IT VAR experience preferred.

- Track record of building and growing partner relationships from Bronze through strategic tier.

- Comfort engaging at all levels of a partner organization, from owner to install tech to CFO.

- Fluency in Salesforce, Excel, and standard business software.

- Ability to work independently, prioritize across competing demands, and operate against quarterly milestones.

- Strong written and verbal communication. Engaging in a partner meeting, disciplined in CRM and email.

- Willing to travel approximately 50% of the time in-territory.

Compensation
The expected base salary range for this position is $90,000 –$100,000. Actual compensation will depend on factors including budget, skills, experience, location, and internal equity. This position may also be eligible for bonuses, equity, or other forms of compensation, where applicable.

Benefits
- Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans (ButterflyMX covers 80% of the cost) starting day 1

- 401(k) plan with a match

- 10 paid holidays, 20 vacation days, 5 sick days, 3 floating holidays

- Basic Life and Accidental Death and Dismemberment Insurance (ButterflyMX covers 100% of the cost)

- Short and Long Term Disability (ButterflyMX covers 100% of the cost)

- And more!

Since 2021, we've been recognized as a Top Workplace in Colorado and secured the #8 spot in the Best Places to Work Multifamily rankings. From our hiring process to our All Hands meetings and Town Halls, our values are at the core of everything we do.

Digible is a privately owned and operated digital marketing company founded in 2017 with a mission to bring cutting-edge solutions to the multifamily industry. We offer a full suite of digital services, alongside Fiona, our predictive analytics platform—the first of its kind.

We believe diversity fuels innovation, and we strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. If you're ready to do the best work of your career, we'd love to have you on the team!

Core Values

- Authenticity — The commitment to be steadfast and genuine with our actions and communication toward everyone we touch.

- Curiosity — The belief that a deep and fundamental curiosity (the "why") in our work is vital to company innovation and evolution.

- Focus — The collective will to remain completely devoted and ultimately accountable to our deliverables.

- Humility — The recognition and daily practice that "we" is always greater than "I".

- Happiness — The decision to prioritize passion and love for what we do above everything else.

The Role

Digible is hiring a Senior Product Manager to found a brand-new pod at the center of our 2026 strategy: productizing Digible's agency operations and customer data, and serving as the connective tissue that turns a collection of services and tools into one coherent experience for both our agency team and our customers.

You'll own the pod's charter, strategy, and roadmap. You won't be starting from zero: there's already a prioritized roadmap ready for you to execute on, so you can ship meaningful work right away. Once you've ramped, we expect you to make that roadmap your own, evolving it through your own discovery and judgment rather than just executing on existing plans. Throughout, you'll partner deeply with our agency operations leaders (your day-one allies and internal customers) to decide what gets solved by people, product, or automation. You'll ship experiences that make Digible dramatically more efficient internally and noticeably better to buy from and work with externally.

Like every pod, this one will also have new technology product opportunities to explore. You'll help find, validate, and shape them alongside the rest of the roadmap.

You'll work on integrations, customer data architecture, core platform, and workflow productization, and you should be excited by exactly that kind of work. You'll also run customer discovery and research, build real relationships with customers and stakeholders, and set and communicate strategy clearly enough to bring the company with you. The work splits roughly evenly between internal-facing and customer-facing product, and a good amount of it is technical. As a senior member of the team, you'll help lead AI transformation across product, design, and engineering. This is a role for someone who loves hands-on IC work. For the right person, it can also open a path into product management leadership as our org scales. You'll report to the VP of Product.

We're a small product org inside a profitable, bootstrapped company — nine years successful before the recent AI wave, and now in the middle of an AI transformation, reinventing how an established company operates and thrives in the AI era. Profitability and bootstrapping mean you'll work on real customer and business problems, not a search for product/market fit, with a direct line to an accessible leadership team. You'll use AI throughout your workflow to move faster and more effectively than a team our size normally could.

You'll Love This Job If You Love:

Products with…

- 🧵 Connective Tissue: unifying fragmented tools and services into one coherent customer experience

- 🏢 Two Sets of Customers: internal agency teams and external customers, roughly half and half — you'll build for both

- ✨ AI: deciding what gets solved by people, product, or automation — and using AI to shift that line

Roles with…

- 🌱 0→1 Building: founding a brand-new pod with a clear mandate and a prioritized starting roadmap you'll quickly make your own

- 🔭 New Bets: exploring new technology product opportunities and shaping what we build next

- 🧭 A Leadership Path: loving senior IC work for the long haul, with potential to grow into player/coach leadership as the org scales

Organizations with…

- 🚀 Small Teams: working with small teams that trade scale for agility & autonomy

- 🏗️ Early Foundations: crafting the systems, rituals, and mindsets of a relatively new product org

Cultures with…

- 📅 4-day Workweek: we work Mon–Thu, so every weekend is a long weekend

- ⚖️ Modeled Balance: we know work is a part of life — boundaries are modeled by leadership

Businesses with…

- 📈 Fast Growth: this isn't a turnaround — 371% three-year growth per the 2025 Inc. 5000 (No. 1,165)

- 🥾 Bootstrapped Profitability: we control our own destiny, with no investor or burn pressure

What You'll Do:

- 💡 Customer Discovery & Research: run real discovery with customers, agency teams, and the market, and keep making time for it even when the roadmap is loud — understand our customers and business deeply enough to see the unifying product beneath them

- 🧭 Pod Strategy & Roadmap: execute on a prioritized starting roadmap from day one, then build your pod's strategy from the VP-level product vision and strategy (and influence both) and own the roadmap and execution from there

- 🛠️ 0→1 Execution: lead discovery and delivery of foundational platform experiences — integrations, customer data architecture, and workflow productization

- 🔭 New Product Exploration: explore and validate new technology product opportunities for Digible, from customer and market discovery to a clear case for what's worth building

- 🤝 Stakeholder Partnership: treat agency ops leaders, executives, and customers as partners, not requesters — decide together what gets solved by people, product, or automation, and keep everyone aligned through clear, consistent communication

- 🏁 End-to-End Delivery: ship the full experience, customer-facing and internal, including enablement and change management

- 📏 Measure Impact: instrument a brand-new domain so success is measurable from day one — inventing creative or technical ways to get data that doesn't exist yet

- 🌱 Emerging Leadership: mentor PMs and agency team members, shape team rituals, and grow deliberately toward player/coach people leadership over time

- 🧠 Product Taste: make the right calls consistently in our most ambiguous domain — problem-first, creative yet analytical, with a high bar for what deserves to ship

- 📡 Industry Trends: stay ahead of AI and product trends — and educate the team and stakeholders on what matters

How Success Will Be Measured:

Business Metrics

- $ Operational Efficiency: measurably reduce manual effort by productizing services and automating workflows

- $ Revenue Retention & Expansion: customer experiences that make clients stay and grow

Product Metrics

- Time-to-Value: customers reach value faster on what you ship

- Adoption: internal teams and customers actually run on what you ship

- CSAT: internal and external customers trust and prefer what you ship

What You Should Have:

Must Have

- 5+ years of product management experience

- 2+ years of AI product experience

- Technical depth to work on integrations, customer data architecture, core platform, and workflow productization — and genuine excitement for that type of work

- Proven 0→1 ownership: took an ambiguous, mission-critical product area from nothing to shipped and adopted — with the product taste to know what deserved to exist

- Customer discovery and research fluency — you talk to customers directly, and your product decisions trace back to what you learned

- Strategic and communication range — you can set a strategy, make the case for it, and keep executives, ops leaders, and engineers moving in the same direction

- Cross-functional leadership without authority — you treat stakeholders as customers and partners, and have aligned ops, eng, and business teams around one strategy

- Genuine desire to grow into product management leadership — this seat is our future people-leader bench

Preferred

- Small start-up (<150 people) experience

- Experience productizing internal operations or building workflow/integration products

- Tech-enabled services or hybrid product-service business experience

Bonus

- Digital marketing domain knowledge (strategy, metrics, and technology)

- Real estate domain knowledge (ex: rentals, multifamily, single family, etc.)

Physical Requirements

- Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

- Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times

Pay, Perks and More!

- $150,000 - $180,000 annually

- 4-Day Work Week (32 Hour Work Week)

- Mental and Physical Wellness Reimbursement Benefit

- $1000/year travel fund for employees who have been with Digible 3+ years

- Financial wellness coaching for all team members!

- Dog-Friendly Office

HEADS UP! We believe in transparency throughout our hiring process. To help us ensure a great fit, we'll ask you to share a few professional references during the hiring process who can speak to your experience and skills. It’s all part of our commitment to open, honest communication and our core values: Focus, Authenticity, Humility, Curiosity, and Happiness.

jobs.description:
About Roofstock

What we do and why we do it

As the leading end-to-end investment platform for single-family rental homes (SFR), our mission is to reinvent the rental housing ecosystem for the benefit of all. We successfully merge our passion for helping investors build wealth through real estate with cutting edge technology that transforms the way they do it.

How it’s going (and growing)

With a talented team of 750+ Roofsters, our collaborative, can-do culture is what fuels our growth. In 2022, we closed on our Series E, raising $240 million, and have offices in the Bay Area and New York City. Our growth includes recent acquisitions of Stessa (financial and asset management software), RentPrep (tenant screening and placement service for landlords), and Mynd (property management platform for both Retail and Institutional investors). In 2025, Roofstock took an ownership stake in Casago (short-term rental management services), expanding our platform to support both long-term and short-term rental investment services.

About the Role

The Senior Product Manager, Leasing is the dedicated product leader for Leasing on the Leasing & Resident Experience team. This is a hands-on, high-ownership position over a revenue-carrying surface for someone who thrives at the intersection of Product, Operations, and Growth. You will own the leasing roadmap end to end, deliver the products that help our teams lease more homes faster, and shape new leasing offerings for the landlords who manage on their own.

This role is built for an operator-minded product manager with a bias toward action, a focus on driving outcomes, strong written communication, and a genuine curiosity about how homes actually get leased. If you look at a leasing pipeline and your first instinct is to find the stage where prospects quietly stall, then fix the system so it stops happening, this is your job.

What You'll Own

Product Strategy and Roadmap

- Own the leasing product roadmap across our retail, institutional, and build-to-rent portfolios, balancing platform commitments against growth opportunities

- Lead initiatives from discovery through execution, partnering with Engineering and Design on scoping, rollout planning, and post-launch impact analysis

- Keep priorities, sizing, and sequencing legible so leadership, engineering, and operations are all reading from the same plan

Leasing Funnel Performance

- Build the visibility and workflow layer for the leasing funnel so handoffs, service levels, and automation status are clear and the team sees what needs attention without digging

- Partner with leasing operations to remove bottlenecks and help the team absorb more volume without proportionally adding headcount

- Understand how AI is working within the leasing funnel, from screening to scheduling to prospect communication, well enough to push automation where it helps and catch quality issues before customers do

New Leasing Offerings

- Shape and validate new leasing products and services for self-managing landlords, from customer discovery through pricing and business modeling

- Partner with Growth and go-to-market teams to take new offerings from thesis to launch

Customer Research and Insight

- Talk directly to the people who live in the funnel, including owners, prospects, leasing agents, and screeners, and synthesize what you hear into decisions the team can act on

- Build and maintain the feedback loops that keep operational signals flowing into product decisions in real time, not after the damage is done

Cross-functional Operations

- Serve as the product counterpart to Engineering and Design and the point of contact for cross-team dependencies across sales, operations, and account management

- Support prioritization decisions by balancing strategic goals and operational capacity

Data and Metrics

- Own leasing funnel metrics end to end, including conversion, speed to lease, service-level adherence, and vacancy

- Develop and track KPIs that surface risks and opportunities early, and identify root causes when results deviate from expectations

What We're Looking For

- 5 or more years of product management experience, including ownership of a revenue-carrying product surface at a software company

- Proptech, real estate, or marketplace background strongly preferred; leasing or property management context is a strong plus. You should know, or be hungry to learn, how a home actually gets leased

- Grit. You've shipped through ambiguity and constraint, and you can tell us how

- Strong roadmap and stakeholder management. You can hold deadline-bound platform work and growth bets in the same quarter and keep both moving

- Comfort in an operator-heavy business; your best discovery starts by shadowing the people doing the work today

- AI fluency. You use AI tools every day and have opinions about where agents belong in a workflow. You don't need to write code, but you should have put AI into a product, not just into your own productivity

- Comfort working with data; you can define funnel metrics, read a dashboard, and root-cause a number that moved the wrong way

- Strong written communication. You can take a messy situation and write a clear one-pager about it

- Genuine curiosity about customers and comfort talking to them directly, whether that is an institutional owner, a self-managing landlord, or a prospect stuck in screening

- Bias toward action over perfect planning

Location

This position is classified as a HYBRID work environment in Oakland, CA or NYC, New York.

This is a 2 day hybrid role in the Bay Area office, effective October 2026.

Compensation

$214,000 - $225,000 annual base salary. The compensation range may be adjusted based on experience and location.

Pay Transparency

Our compensation reflects several US geographic markets. The base pay for this position represents the expected salary for this position. Ultimately, in determining your pay it will be based on several factors including location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience and other job related factors. Roofstock is a total compensation company; the base salary is only part of our total compensation package.

Competitive & Unique Benefits Package

- Generous PTO Policy

- 13 Paid Holidays

- Volunteer Time Off

- Paid Parental Leave

- 401k Program

- Wellness and home office/cell phone subsidies

- Robust health, dental, vision insurance, and more

Authorization to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment and we are unable to sponsor H1-B Visas at this time.

Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity

The company provides equal opportunity in all of our employment practices to all qualified employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender expression, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, genetic information or any other category protected by federal, state and local laws. This policy applies to all aspects of the employment relationship, including recruitment, hiring, compensation, promotion, transfer, disciplinary action, layoff, return from layoff, training and social, and recreational programs. All such employment decisions will be made without unlawfully discriminating on any prohibited basis.
